Mctt.Core.Syntactic.System.Global.LookupSound

Lookup is Sound

What a well-formed module expression denotes (mdenote, Γ ⊢ H ⇝ R) is what a unit equal to it describes: H is equal to a unit K, a filed module at arguments P N⃗ or a literal (U), and K denotes the same module part.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia List PeanoNat.
From Mctt Require Import LibTactics.
From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.
From Mctt.Core.Syntactic.System.Global Require Export MemberWf.
From Mctt.Core.Syntactic.System Require Export Lemmas.
Import Syntax_Notations Wk_Notations GlobalCtx_Notations.
#[local] Open Scope list_scope.

The Parts of a Well-formed Unit

The parts of a well-formed unit (unit_full) are invariant under moving parameters between the unit and the context, so a well-formed unit stays well formed when abstracted over the context's top or given its outermost parameter.
Relevant parameters have sorts, by their positions from the outside: the universe at the level or LevelSort (param_sorts of the unit rules).
Lemma params_evaluated_sorts : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ l, params_evaluated Θ Ξ Γ Δ l ->
    exists ps, (forall k, parameter_sort l (ps k)) /\
      forall Δ1 κ T Δ2, Δ = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ2 ++ Γ ⊢ T : ps (List.length Δ2).
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Γ Δ l; induction Δ as [| e Δ IH]; intros HR.
  - exists (fun _ => Typeω@l); split; [ intros; constructor | intros [| ? ?] ? ? ? E; discriminate ].
  - destruct IH as (ps & Hps & HT).
    { intros Δ1 κ T Δ2 E; apply (HR (e :: Δ1) κ); rewrite E; reflexivity. }
    assert (Hin : forall Δ1 κ T Δ2, Δ = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 -> List.length Δ2 <> List.length Δ)
      by (intros * E; subst Δ; rewrite List.length_app; cbn; lia).
    destruct e as [κ B | B N | U | B N U].
    2-4: exists ps; split; [ exact Hps | intros [| e' Δ1] κ' T Δ2 E; cbn in E; [ discriminate | injection E as _ E; exact (HT _ _ _ _ E) ] ].
    assert (HB : param_typed Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) B l) by exact (HR nil κ B Δ eq_refl).
    destruct HB as [HB | HB]; [ exists (fun k => if Nat.eqb k (List.length Δ) then Typeω@l else ps k)
                              | exists (fun k => if Nat.eqb k (List.length Δ) then LevelSort else ps k) ];
      (split; [ intros k; destruct (Nat.eqb k (List.length Δ)); [ constructor | apply Hps ] |]);
      intros [| e' Δ1] κ' T Δ2 E; cbn in E;
      first [ injection E as <- <- <-; rewrite Nat.eqb_refl; exact HB
            | injection E as _ E; rewrite (proj2 (Nat.eqb_neq _ _) (Hin _ _ _ _ E)); exact (HT _ _ _ _ E) ].
Qed.

A description whose module part has no member of a type of levels has none.
Lemma no_level_of_mod : forall Θ Ξ Γ R R', mdesc_mod R = Some R' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R.
Proof.
  intros * Hm HN; destruct R; cbn in Hm; try discriminate; try (injection Hm as <-; exact HN).
  constructor; intros Rm' HRm; rewrite Hm in HRm; injection HRm as <-; exact HN.
Qed.

A unit of the context after Δ, abstracted over Δ: when Δ is of types of levels, or what the unit denotes there has no member of a type of levels (the flag premise for Δ).
Lemma unit_full_abs : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ U l, unit_full Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) U -> all_assumptions Δ -> params_evaluated Θ Ξ Γ Δ l ->
    (level_sorted_parameters Δ \/ forall R, udenote Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) None U R -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R) ->
    unit_full Θ Ξ Γ (gunit_abs Δ U).
Proof.
  intros * HU HaΔ HRΔ HLΔ; destruct U as [Δy [[] Φ | E]]; cbn in HU |- *; try contradiction.
  - destruct HU as [Φx es lp ps Hps Hx HC Hes Htg Hd Ho Ha Hs Hsx Hn Hp lv Rt [Hs1 Hd1 Hn1] Hff].
    destruct (params_evaluated_sorts _ _ _ _ _
                (params_evaluated_app _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (params_evaluated_of_sorts _ _ _ _ _ _ Hps Hp) HRΔ)) as (ps' & Hps' & Hp').
    (* the flag premise over both telescopes *)
    assert (HF' : exists lv' Rt', levels_flag Θ Ξ Γ (Δy ++ Δ) (me_lit (gu_open nil Φ)) lv' Rt').
    { destruct lv; [ destruct HLΔ as [HL | HN] |].
      - exists true, Rt; constructor; [ intros _; exact (level_sorted_app _ _ (Hs1 eq_refl) HL) | discriminate | discriminate ].
      - assert (HuR : udenote Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) None (gu_open Δy Φ) (mdesc_open Δy Φ Φx))
          by (eapply udenote_body; [ exact Hx | reflexivity ]).
        exists false, (mdesc_open nil Φ Φx); constructor; [ discriminate | intros _ | intros _ ].
        + apply mdenote_lit; eapply udenote_body; [ cbn [List.app]; rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact Hx | reflexivity ].
        + eapply no_level_open_shift; [| exact (HN _ HuR) ]; cbn [List.app]; rewrite List.app_assoc; reflexivity.
      - exists false, Rt; constructor; [ discriminate | intros _; rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact (Hd1 eq_refl)
                                      | intros _; rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact (Hn1 eq_refl) ]. }
    destruct HF' as (lv' & Rt' & HF').
    refine (mk_unit_body_full _ _ _ _ _ Φx es (max lp l) ps' Hps' _ _ Hes Htg _ _ _ Hs Hsx Hn Hp' lv' Rt' HF' _).
    all: rewrite <- ?List.app_assoc; first [ assumption | apply List.Forall_app; split; assumption ].
  - destruct HU as [lp ps Hps HΔ Ha HE Hp lv Rt [Hs1 Hd1 Hn1] Hff].
    destruct (params_evaluated_sorts _ _ _ _ _
                (params_evaluated_app _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (params_evaluated_of_sorts _ _ _ _ _ _ Hps Hp) HRΔ)) as (ps' & Hps' & Hp').
    assert (HF' : exists lv' Rt', levels_flag Θ Ξ Γ (Δy ++ Δ) E lv' Rt').
    { destruct lv; [ destruct HLΔ as [HL | HN] |].
      - exists true, Rt; constructor; [ intros _; exact (level_sorted_app _ _ (Hs1 eq_refl) HL) | discriminate | discriminate ].
      - destruct (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 denote_exists)))))) _ _ _ _ _ HE) as (_ & (RE & RE' & HmE & HmdE) & _).
        pose proof (HN _ (udenote_alias _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HmE HmdE)) as HNu.
        pose proof (proj1 (no_level_up_mod _ _ _ _ _ (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ HmdE)) HNu) as HN'.
        exists false, RE; constructor; [ discriminate | intros _; rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact HmE
                                       | intros _; rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact (no_level_of_mod _ _ _ _ _ HmdE HN') ].
      - exists false, Rt; constructor; [ discriminate | intros _; rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact (Hd1 eq_refl)
                                      | intros _; rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact (Hn1 eq_refl) ]. }
    destruct HF' as (lv' & Rt' & HF').
    refine (mk_unit_alias_full _ _ _ _ _ (max lp l) ps' Hps' _ _ _ Hp' lv' Rt' HF' _).
    all: rewrite <- ?List.app_assoc; first [ assumption | apply List.Forall_app; split; assumption ].
Qed.

The flag premise of a body holds of its expansion: the expansion denotes the description with the same expansion, and having no member of a type of levels reads the expansion only.
Lemma levels_flag_expand : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ Φ lv Rt,
    levels_flag Θ Ξ Γ Δ (me_lit (gu_open nil Φ)) lv Rt ->
    exists Rt', levels_flag Θ Ξ Γ Δ (me_lit (gu_open nil (gm_expand Φ))) lv Rt'.
Proof.
  intros * [Hs Hd Hn]; destruct lv.
  - exists Rt; constructor; [ exact Hs | discriminate | discriminate ].
  - specialize (Hd eq_refl); specialize (Hn eq_refl).
    inversion Hd; subst; try (cbn in *; discriminate).
    match goal with Hu : udenote _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => inversion Hu; subst end.
    match goal with HR : mdesc_body _ _ _ _ _ = Some _ |- _ => cbn in HR; injection HR as <- end.
    match goal with Hx : body_xp _ _ _ Φ _ |- _ => pose proof (body_xp_expand _ _ _ _ _ Hx) as -> end.
    exists (mdesc_open nil (gm_expand Φ) (gm_expand Φ)); constructor; [ discriminate | intros _ | intros _ ].
    + apply mdenote_lit; eapply udenote_body; [ apply body_xp_noopen, gm_noopen_expand | reflexivity ].
    + inversion Hn; subst; econstructor; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma unit_full_of_eq : forall Θ Ξ Γ U U',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' -> unit_full Θ Ξ Γ U /\ unit_full Θ Ξ Γ U'.
Proof.
  induction 1; cbn; try solve [ intuition eauto ].
  - match goal with Hb : body_xp _ _ _ _ Φx |- _ => pose proof (body_xp_nopens _ _ _ _ _ Hb) as Hnp end.
    match goal with Hsx : body_shape Φx Φx' |- _ =>
      rename Hsx into Hsx0;
      destruct (body_shape_fill _ _ Hnp Hsx0) as [Hf Hf'];
      destruct (body_shape_refl _ _ Hsx0) as (Hsx1 & Hsx2 & _) end.
    match goal with Hb1 : body_xp _ _ _ Φ Φx, Hb2 : body_xp _ _ _ Φ' Φx' |- _ =>
      pose proof (body_shape_of_xp _ _ _ _ _ Hb1 Hsx1) as Hs1; pose proof (body_shape_of_xp _ _ _ _ _ Hb2 Hsx2) as Hs2;
      assert (Hnames : gm_names Φ = gm_names Φ')
        by (rewrite <- (body_xp_names _ _ _ _ _ Hb1), <- (body_xp_names _ _ _ _ _ Hb2); exact (proj2 (proj2 (body_shape_refl _ _ Hsx0)))) end.
    match goal with Hx : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ˣ body_ctx Φx ++ _ ≈ _, Hx' : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ˣ body_ctx Φx' ++ _ ≈ _ |- _ =>
      pose proof (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ Hx) as Hl; pose proof (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ Hx') as Hr end.
    rewrite <- app_assoc in Hl, Hr.
    split; [ eapply (mk_unit_body_full _ _ _ _ _ Φx entry_sort param_level param_sorts)
           | eapply (mk_unit_body_full _ _ _ _ _ Φx' entry_sort param_level param_sorts) ];
      try eassumption; try (rewrite <- Hnames; eassumption); try (eapply mk_levels_flag; eassumption).
    + intros y Φ0 E A M σ Hp HE Hf0.
      destruct (shape_prefix _ _ _ _ _ Hsx0 Hp) as (Φ0' & E' & Hp' & _ & HS).
      destruct (fill_prefix _ _ _ _ Hf' Hp') as (σ' & Hf0').
      destruct (entry_shape_tm _ _ _ _ HS HE) as (A' & M' & HE').
      split; eauto.
    + intros y Φ0' E' A M σ' Hp' HE' Hf0'.
      destruct (shape_prefix _ _ _ _ _ (body_shape_sym _ _ Hsx0) Hp') as (Φ0 & E & Hp & _ & HS).
      destruct (fill_prefix _ _ _ _ Hf Hp) as (σ & Hf0).
      destruct (entry_shape_tm _ _ _ _ HS HE') as (A0 & M0 & HE).
      split; eauto.
  - pose proof (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ H) as Hl; pose proof (ext_eq_ctx_right _ _ _ _ _ H) as Hr.
    split; [ eapply (mk_unit_alias_full _ _ _ _ _ param_level param_sorts)
           | eapply (mk_unit_alias_full _ _ _ _ _ param_level param_sorts) ];
      first [ eassumption | eapply wf_modexp_eq_refl_left; eassumption | eapply mk_levels_flag; eassumption ].
  - (* an alias of a literal, and the literal over both telescopes *)
    split; [ exact (mk_unit_alias_full _ _ _ _ _ param_level param_sorts H2 (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ H) H0 (wf_me_lit _ _ _ _ _ H1) H3 lv Rt
                     (mk_levels_flag _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H4 H5 H6) H7) |].
    change (unit_full Θ Ξ Γ (gunit_abs Δ (gu_mk Δ' D))).
    apply (unit_full_abs _ _ _ _ _ param_level (proj1 IHwf_unit_eq) H0 (params_evaluated_of_sorts _ _ _ _ _ _ H2 H3)).
    (* the flag premise for the outer parameters, as unit_full_abs takes it *)
    destruct lv; [ left; exact (H4 eq_refl) | right; intros R HR ].
    pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ H)) as Hg.
    assert (HmR : mdenote Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) (me_lit (gu_mk Δ' D)) R) by (apply mdenote_lit; exact HR).
    rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ HmR _ (H5 eq_refl)); exact (H6 eq_refl).
  - (* a body and its expansion: the expansion is its own, with no opens *)
    destruct IHwf_unit_eq as [HF _]; split; [ exact HF |].
    destruct HF as [Φx es lp ps Hps Hx HC Hes Htg Hd Ho Ha Hs Hsx Hn Hp lv Rt HL Hff].
    pose proof (body_xp_expand _ _ _ _ _ Hx) as ->.
    destruct (levels_flag_expand _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HL) as (Rt' & HL').
    refine (mk_unit_body_full _ _ _ _ _ (gm_expand Φ) es lp ps Hps _ HC Hes Htg Hd _ Ha Hsx Hsx _ Hp lv Rt' HL' _).
    + apply body_xp_noopen, gm_noopen_expand.
    + intros k Ψ H0 Hk; rewrite (body_opens_noopen _ (gm_noopen_expand _)), nth_error_nil in Hk; discriminate Hk.
    + rewrite (body_xp_names _ _ _ _ _ Hx); exact Hn.
    + intros k Ψ H0 Hk; rewrite (body_opens_noopen _ (gm_noopen_expand _)), nth_error_nil in Hk; discriminate Hk.
Qed.

Lemma unit_full_ctx : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ D, unit_full Θ Ξ Γ (gu_mk Δ D) -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ /\ all_assumptions Δ.
Proof.
  intros * HU; destruct D as [[] Φ | E]; cbn in HU; try contradiction.
  - destruct HU as [Φx es lp ps _ _ HC _ _ _ _ Ha]; split; [ exact (ctx_app_wf_tail _ _ _ _ HC) | exact Ha ].
  - destruct HU as [lp ps _ HΔ Ha]; split; assumption.
Qed.

The parameters of a unit are relevant.
Lemma unit_full_params : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ D, unit_full Θ Ξ Γ (gu_mk Δ D) -> exists l, params_evaluated Θ Ξ Γ Δ l.
Proof.
  intros * HU; destruct D as [[] Φ | E]; cbn in HU; try contradiction.
  - destruct HU as [Φx es lp ps Hps _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hp]; exists lp; exact (params_evaluated_of_sorts _ _ _ _ _ _ Hps Hp).
  - destruct HU as [lp ps Hps _ _ _ Hp]; exists lp; exact (params_evaluated_of_sorts _ _ _ _ _ _ Hps Hp).
Qed.

The flag premise over Δy ++ Δ, read with Δ in the context.
Lemma unabs_levels_flag : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ Δy E (lv : bool) Rt,
    levels_flag Θ Ξ Γ (Δy ++ Δ) E lv Rt -> levels_flag Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) Δy E lv Rt.
Proof.
  intros * [Hs Hd Hn]; constructor.
  - intros Hl; exact (proj1 (level_sorted_app_inv _ _ (Hs Hl))).
  - intros Hl; rewrite List.app_assoc; exact (Hd Hl).
  - intros Hl; rewrite List.app_assoc; exact (Hn Hl).
Qed.

A unit's innermost parameters Δy, the others being in the context.
Lemma unit_full_unabs : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ Δy D, unit_full Θ Ξ Γ (gu_mk (Δy ++ Δ) D) -> unit_full Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) (gu_mk Δy D).
Proof.
  intros * HU; destruct D as [[] Φ | E]; cbn in HU |- *; try contradiction.
  - destruct HU as [Φx es lp ps Hps Hx HC Hes Htg Hd Ho Ha Hs Hsx Hn Hp lv Rt HF Hff].
    rewrite <- !List.app_assoc in Hx, HC, Hd, Ho, Hff.
    refine (mk_unit_body_full _ _ _ _ _ Φx es lp (fun k => ps (k + length Δ)) (fun k => Hps _) Hx HC Hes Htg Hd Ho
              _ Hs Hsx Hn _ lv Rt (unabs_levels_flag _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HF) Hff).
    + apply List.Forall_app in Ha; apply Ha.
    + intros Δ1 κ T Δ2 Heq; rewrite List.app_assoc, <- List.length_app.
      apply (Hp Δ1 κ); rewrite Heq, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity.
  - destruct HU as [lp ps Hps HΔ Ha HE Hp lv Rt HF Hff].
    rewrite <- !List.app_assoc in HΔ, HE, Hff.
    refine (mk_unit_alias_full _ _ _ _ _ lp (fun k => ps (k + length Δ)) (fun k => Hps _) HΔ _ HE _ lv Rt
              (unabs_levels_flag _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HF) Hff).
    + apply List.Forall_app in Ha; apply Ha.
    + intros Δ1 κ T Δ2 Heq; rewrite List.app_assoc, <- List.length_app.
      apply (Hp Δ1 κ); rewrite Heq, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity.
Qed.

A unit given its outermost parameter.
Lemma unit_full_beta : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ κ X D N,
    unit_full Θ Ξ Γ (gu_mk (Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) D) -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N : X ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ (gu_mk Δ D)[Id,,N]ᵘ ≈ (gu_mk Δ D)[Id,,N]ᵘ.
Proof.
  intros * HU HN.
  pose proof (unit_full_unabs _ _ _ _ _ _ HU) as HU1; cbn [List.app] in HU1.
  destruct (unit_full_ctx _ _ _ _ _ HU1) as [HC _].
  destruct (ctx_decomp_sort_kind (ctx_app_wf_tail _ _ _ _ HC)) as [_ (Si & HSi & HX)].
  eapply sub_preserves_unit; [ exact (unit_eq_of_full _ _ _ _ HU1) | exact (wf_sub_single _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HX HSi HN) ].
Qed.

Descriptions of Well-formed Module Expressions


Lemma me_denotes : forall Θ Ξ Γ H H', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> exists R Rm, mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H R /\ mdesc_mod R = Some Rm.
Proof.
  intros * HH; destruct (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 denote_exists)))))) _ _ _ _ _ HH) as (_ & HR & _); exact HR.
Qed.

Lemma me_desc_ok : forall Θ Ξ Γ H H' R, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R.
Proof.
  intros * HH Hm.
  pose proof (gctx_valid_syn _ _ (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH))) as Hv.
  destruct (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 desc_typed)))))) _ _ _ _ _ HH Hv) as (_ & HR & _); exact (HR _ Hm).
Qed.

Lemma desc_ok_tele : forall Θ Ξ Γ Rm, desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ Rm -> mdesc_is_mod Rm -> exists T, mdesc_tele Rm = Some T.
Proof.
  intros * Hok Hm; inversion Hok; subst; cbn in Hm |- *; try contradiction; [ eauto |].
  match goal with Ha : args_ok _ _ _ ?T ?Ns |- _ => pose proof (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ Ha) as Hl end.
  apply Nat.leb_le in Hl; rewrite Hl; eauto.
Qed.

A parameter type of a universe or of levels: of an evaluated sort.
Lemma param_typed_evaluated : forall Θ Ξ Γ T l, param_typed Θ Ξ Γ T l ->
    exists Srt, evaluated_sort Srt /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ T : Srt.
Proof. intros * [H | H]; eexists; (split; [ constructor | exact H ]). Qed.

Lemma mdesc_is_mod_sub : forall R σ, mdesc_is_mod R -> mdesc_is_mod (mdesc_sub R σ).
Proof. intros * H; destruct R; cbn in *; tauto. Qed.

What a Well-formed Module Expression is Made of


Definition gen_m (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) (H : modexp) : Prop :=
  match H with
  | me_lit U => unit_full Θ Ξ Γ U
  | me_mem H0 _ => Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H0 ≈ H0
  | me_app H0 N =>
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H0 ≈ H0 /\
      exists R T B T1 Srt, mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H0 R /\ mdesc_mod_tele R = Some T /\ tele_view T = Some (B, T1) /\
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ B : Srt /\ evaluated_sort Srt /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N : B
  | _ => True
  end.

A literal given its outermost parameter: the literal is a module whose telescope ends in the parameter.
Lemma gen_beta : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ κ X D N,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_mk (Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) D ≈ gu_mk (Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) D -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N : X ->
    gen_m Θ Ξ Γ (me_app (me_lit (gu_mk (Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) D)) N) /\
    gen_m Θ Ξ Γ (me_lit (gu_mk Δ D)[Id,,N]ᵘ).
Proof.
  intros * HU HN.
  pose proof (proj1 (unit_full_of_eq _ _ _ _ _ HU)) as Hf.
  split; [| exact (proj1 (unit_full_of_eq _ _ _ _ _ (unit_full_beta _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hf HN))) ].
  split; [ apply wf_me_lit; exact HU |].
  (* the parameter is relevant, as every parameter of a unit *)
  destruct (unit_full_params _ _ _ _ _ Hf) as [i HRp].
  pose proof (HRp Δ κ X nil eq_refl) as HX0; cbn [List.app] in HX0.
  destruct (param_typed_evaluated _ _ _ _ _ HX0) as (SX & HSX & HX).
  destruct D as [[] Φ | E]; cbn in Hf; try contradiction.
  - destruct Hf as [Φx es lp ps Hps Hx].
    exists (mdesc_open (Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) Φ Φx), (Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil), X, Δ, SX.
    split; [ apply mdenote_lit; eapply udenote_body; [ exact Hx | reflexivity ] |].
    split; [ reflexivity |]; split; [ apply tele_view_last |]; split; [| split ]; assumption.
  - destruct Hf as [lp ps Hps HΔ _ HE].
    destruct (me_denotes _ _ _ _ _ HE) as (R & Rm & HR & HRm).
    pose proof (desc_ok_mod _ _ (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΔ) _ _ _ (me_desc_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ HE HR) HRm) as Hok.
    pose proof (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ HRm) as Hmod.
    destruct (desc_ok_tele _ _ _ _ Hok Hmod) as (T & Ht).
    exists (mdesc_up (Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) Rm), (T ++ Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil), X, (T ++ Δ), SX.
    split; [ apply mdenote_lit; eapply udenote_alias; eassumption |].
    split; [ unfold mdesc_mod_tele; rewrite (mdesc_is_mod_mod _ (mdesc_is_mod_up _ _ Hmod)); apply mdesc_tele_up; exact Ht |].
    split; [ rewrite app_assoc; apply tele_view_last |]; split; [| split ]; assumption.
Qed.

The Unit a Typed Module Part Stands for Is Well Formed

Arguments for a telescope, but the last.
Lemma args_ok_init : forall Θ Ξ Γ T Ns N l, args_ok Θ Ξ Γ T (Ns ++ N :: nil) -> params_evaluated Θ Ξ nil T l ->
    args_ok Θ Ξ Γ T Ns /\ exists T1 κ C T2, T = T1 ++ ce_ass κ C :: T2 /\ length T2 = length Ns /\
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list Id Ns : T2 ++ Γ /\
      (exists Srt, evaluated_sort Srt /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ T2 ++ Γ ⊢ C : Srt) /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N : C[sb_of_list Id Ns].
Proof.
  intros * [T1 T2 -> Hl Ha Hs HT2 HN] HRT.
  destruct T2 as [| e T2']; [ rewrite length_app in Hl; cbn in Hl; lia |].
  pose proof Ha as Ha0; apply List.Forall_cons_iff in Ha0 as [(κ & C & ->) Ha'].
  assert (Hl' : length T2' = length Ns) by (rewrite length_app in Hl; cbn in Hl; lia).
  cbn [List.app] in HT2; destruct (ctx_decomp HT2) as [HT2' _].
  (* the parameter, relevant in the closed telescope, read over Γ *)
  pose proof (HRT T1 κ C T2' eq_refl) as HC0; rewrite List.app_nil_r in HC0.
  assert (Hs2 : ctx_scoped 0 T2')
    by (change (ce_ass κ C :: T2') with ((ce_ass κ C :: nil) ++ T2') in Hs; exact (proj2 (proj1 (ctx_scoped_app_iff _ _) Hs))).
  assert (HC : exists Srt, evaluated_sort Srt /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ T2' ++ Γ ⊢ C : Srt)
    by (destruct HC0 as [HC0 | HC0]; eexists; (split; [ constructor | exact (closed_tele_weaken_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs2 HC0 HT2') ])).
  assert (Hins : tele_insts (ce_ass κ C :: T2') Id (Ns ++ N :: nil) = tele_insts T2' Id Ns ++ C[sb_of_list Id Ns] :: nil).
  { change (ce_ass κ C :: T2') with ((ce_ass κ C :: nil) ++ T2').
    rewrite tele_insts_app by (first [ exact Ha' | symmetry; exact Hl' ]); reflexivity. }
  rewrite Hins in HN.
  assert (HNs : forall k M A, nth_error Ns k = Some M -> nth_error (tele_insts T2' Id Ns) k = Some A -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A).
  { intros k M A HM HA; apply (HN k); [ rewrite nth_error_app1; [ exact HM | apply nth_error_Some; congruence ] |].
    rewrite nth_error_app1; [ exact HA | apply nth_error_Some; congruence ]. }
  split.
  - exists (T1 ++ ce_ass κ C :: nil) T2'; [ rewrite <- app_assoc; reflexivity | exact Hl' | exact Ha'
                                          | destruct Hs; assumption | exact HT2' | exact HNs ].
  - exists T1, κ, C, T2'; split; [ reflexivity |]; split; [ exact Hl' |].
    split; [ exact (wf_sub_of_list_id _ _ _ _ _ Ha' HT2' (eq_sym Hl') HNs) |].
    split; [ exact HC |].
    apply (HN (length Ns)); [ rewrite nth_error_app2, Nat.sub_diag by lia; reflexivity |].
    assert (Hlt : length (tele_insts T2' Id Ns) = length Ns) by (rewrite length_tele_insts by exact Ha'; lia).
    rewrite nth_error_app2 by lia; rewrite Hlt, Nat.sub_diag; reflexivity.
Qed.

The parent of a stored module is stored.
Lemma loc_parent : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall mq y T Φ, loc Θ Ξ (qname_in mq y) T Φ ->
    exists T' Φ', loc Θ Ξ mq T' Φ'.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg * Hl; destruct Hl as [Hf | Hb].
  - unfold gc_frame in Hf.
    destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ (qname_in mq y)) as [[[[Δ [[|] Φ0 | E]] [| ? ?]] T0] |] eqn:Ht; try discriminate.
    destruct (frame_parent _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ Ht) as (T' & Φ' & Hf' & _).
    exists T', Φ'; left; exact Hf'.
  - destruct (gc_body_module _ _ _ _ _ Hb) as [oD Hmd].
    destruct (parent_loc_any _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ Hb Hmd) as (Tq & Φq & Hlq & _).
    exists Tq, Φq; exact Hlq.
Qed.

Every path a stored module's path extends is stored: its parent is (loc_parent), up the chain.
Lemma path_prefix_loc : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall m2 F T Φ, loc Θ Ξ F T Φ -> forall m1, q_chain F = m1 ++ m2 -> m1 <> nil ->
    exists TΦ, gc_loc Θ Ξ (q_abs (q_unit F) m1) = Some TΦ.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg; induction m2 as [| z m2 IH] using List.rev_ind; intros * Hl m1 Ec Hne.
  - rewrite List.app_nil_r in Ec; rewrite <- Ec.
    destruct F as [u ch]; cbn [q_unit q_chain]; exists (T, Φ); exact (gc_loc_of_loc _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl).
  - rewrite List.app_assoc in Ec.
    assert (EqF : F = qname_in (q_abs (q_unit F) (m1 ++ m2)) z)
      by (destruct F as [u ch]; cbn in Ec |- *; unfold qname_in; cbn; rewrite <- Ec; reflexivity).
    rewrite EqF in Hl; destruct (loc_parent _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ Hl) as (T' & Φ' & Hl').
    exact (IH _ _ _ Hl' m1 eq_refl Hne).
Qed.

An alias stored just below a stored module is a well-formed unit over no context: by its entry's validity (gc_module_alias_valid, syn_V), its parameters the module's telescope extended by assumptions (loc_alias_params).
Lemma gc_module_alias_wf : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall p T Φ y U,
    gc_loc Θ Ξ p = Some (T, Φ) -> gc_module Θ Ξ (qname_in p y) = Some (mr_alias U) -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ⋅ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U.
Proof.
  intros * Hg * Hl Hm.
  destruct (gc_module_alias_unit _ _ _ _ Hm) as (Δa & E & ->).
  destruct (loc_alias_params _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ Hl Hm) as (Δ & EΔ & HΔ); cbn [gu_params] in EΔ.
  assert (Ha : all_assumptions Δa)
    by (rewrite EΔ; apply List.Forall_app; split; [ exact HΔ | exact (gc_loc_tele_all_assumptions _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl) ]).
  destruct (gctx_valid_syn _ _ Hg) as [HΘ HΞ].
  destruct (gc_module_alias_valid _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΘ HΞ Hm) as (T0 & pv & Hv); cbn in Hv.
  destruct Hv as (HE & HwΔ & (l & Hpe) & (lv & Rt & Hlf) & Hden).
  destruct (params_evaluated_sorts _ _ _ _ _ Hpe) as (ps & Hps & HpΔ).
  rewrite <- (app_nil_r Δa) in HwΔ, HE.
  destruct (Hden ⋅ HwΔ) as [(R & HR) Hok]; destruct (Hok R HR) as (_ & _ & Hnf).
  assert (Hff : frame_free_target Θ Ξ (Δa ++ ⋅) E) by (exists R; split; assumption).
  eapply wf_unit_eq_alias with (param_level := l) (param_sorts := ps) (lv := lv) (Rt := Rt) (lv' := lv) (Rt' := Rt);
    [ exact (ext_of_ctx' _ _ _ _ HwΔ) | exact Ha | exact Ha | exact HE | exact HE | exact Hps | exact HpΔ | exact HpΔ
    | exact (levels_flag_sorted _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hlf) | exact (levels_flag_denotes _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hlf)
    | exact (levels_flag_no_level _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hlf)
    | exact (levels_flag_sorted _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hlf) | exact (levels_flag_denotes _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hlf)
    | exact (levels_flag_no_level _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hlf) | exact Hff | exact Hff ].
Qed.

Lemma qname_mod_gen : forall Θ Ξ Γ, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> forall p T Φ, loc Θ Ξ p T Φ -> gen_m Θ Ξ Γ (qname_mod p).
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Γ HΓ [u ch] T Φ Hl; pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΓ) as Hg.
  destruct ch as [| y ch] using List.rev_ind; [ exact I |].
  change {| q_unit := u; q_chain := ch ++ y :: nil |} with (qname_in {| q_unit := u; q_chain := ch |} y) in *.
  rewrite qname_mod_in; cbn [gen_m].
  destruct (loc_parent _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ Hl) as (T' & Φ' & Hp).
  exact (loc_modexp_wf _ _ _ HΓ _ _ _ Hp).
Qed.

A stored module at typed arguments is well formed, and made of well-formed parts.
Lemma filed_apps_wf : forall Θ Ξ Γ, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> forall p T Φ, loc Θ Ξ p T Φ -> all_assumptions T -> ctx_scoped 0 T -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ T ->
    forall Ns, args_ok Θ Ξ Γ T Ns ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_apps (qname_mod p) Ns ≈ me_apps (qname_mod p) Ns /\ gen_m Θ Ξ Γ (me_apps (qname_mod p) Ns).
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Γ HΓ p T Φ Hl Ha Hs HT; pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΓ) as Hg.
  destruct (loc_params_evaluated _ _ _ _ _ (gctx_valid_syn _ _ Hg) Hl) as [lT HRT].
  induction Ns as [| N Ns IH] using List.rev_ind; intros Hargs.
  - split; [ exact (loc_modexp_wf _ _ _ HΓ _ _ _ Hl) | exact (qname_mod_gen _ _ _ HΓ _ _ _ Hl) ].
  - destruct (args_ok_init _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hargs HRT) as (Hargs0 & T1 & κ & C & T2 & HTe & Hl2 & Hσ & (Srt & HSrt & HC) & HN).
    destruct (IH Hargs0) as [HW _].
    destruct (filed_denote _ _ Hg _ _ _ Γ Ns (gc_loc_of_loc _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl)) as (R & Hm & Hmd).
    assert (Ht : mdesc_mod_tele R = Some (tele_sub (T1 ++ ce_ass κ C :: nil) (sb_of_list Id Ns) ++ nil)).
    { unfold mdesc_mod_tele; rewrite Hmd; cbn [mdesc_tele].
      replace (Nat.leb (length Ns) (length T)) with true by (symmetry; apply Nat.leb_le; subst T; rewrite length_app; cbn; lia).
      f_equal; f_equal; f_equal; subst T.
      replace (length (T1 ++ ce_ass κ C :: T2) - length Ns) with (length (T1 ++ ce_ass κ C :: nil)) by (rewrite !length_app; cbn; lia).
      change (T1 ++ ce_ass κ C :: T2) with (T1 ++ (ce_ass κ C :: nil) ++ T2); rewrite app_assoc, firstn_app, firstn_all, Nat.sub_diag; cbn.
      rewrite app_nil_r; reflexivity. }
    assert (Hv : tele_view (tele_sub (T1 ++ ce_ass κ C :: nil) (sb_of_list Id Ns) ++ nil) =
                   Some (C[sb_of_list Id Ns], tele_sub T1 (q (sb_of_list Id Ns))))
      by (rewrite app_nil_r, tele_view_sub, tele_view_last; reflexivity).
    pose proof (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HC ltac:(destruct HSrt; constructor) Hσ) as HB.
    rewrite me_apps_snoc; split.
    + eapply wf_me_app; [ exact HW | exact Hm | exact Ht | exact Hv | exact HB | exact HSrt | exact HN | apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact HN
                        | exact Hm | exact Ht | exact Hv | exact HB | exact HSrt | exact HN ].
    + cbn [gen_m]; split; [ exact HW |]; do 5 eexists; repeat split;
        [ exact Hm | exact Ht | exact Hv | exact HB | exact HSrt | exact HN ].
Qed.

The unit a typed module part read where it is (mdesc_xp) stands for is well formed. The hypothesis mdesc_xp is there because the level field of desc_ok_open is about the description's expansion: read where it is, the expansion is the written body's, so the field is the written body's flag.
Lemma mdesc_unit_wf : forall Θ Ξ Γ Rm, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ Rm -> mdesc_canonical Θ Ξ Rm -> mdesc_is_mod Rm ->
    mdesc_xp Θ Ξ Γ Rm ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ mdesc_unit Rm ≈ mdesc_unit Rm /\ gen_m Θ Ξ Γ (mdesc_unit Rm).
Proof.
  intros * HΓ Hok Hc Hm Hxp.
  pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΓ) as Hg.
  assert (Hlit : forall U, unit_full Θ Ξ Γ U -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_lit U ≈ me_lit U /\ gen_m Θ Ξ Γ (me_lit U))
    by (intros U HU; split; [ apply wf_me_lit, unit_eq_of_full; exact HU | exact HU ]).
  destruct Rm as [A om | Δ Φw Φ | [| e Θ'] p T Φ Ns | ]; cbn in Hm, Hc, Hxp |- *; try contradiction.
  - (* the written body, its parameters abstracted: the description is
       what the written body denotes there, so its flag is the body's *)
    apply Hlit; inversion Hok as [| ? ? ? ? lΔ HΦ Hn Hent HaΔ Hsh Hnd HUw HRΔ Htg HLΔ | |]; subst.
    apply (unit_full_abs _ _ _ _ _ _ (proj1 (unit_full_of_eq _ _ _ _ _ HUw)) HaΔ HRΔ).
    destruct HLΔ as [HL | HN]; [ left; exact HL | right; intros R HR ].
    inversion HR; subst.
    match goal with Hx : body_xp _ _ _ Φw ?Φ0, Hb : mdesc_body _ _ _ _ _ = Some _ |- _ =>
      cbn [List.app] in Hx;
      rewrite <- (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg)))) _ _ _ Hxp _ Hx) in Hb;
      cbn in Hb; injection Hb as <- end.
    exact HN.
  - inversion Hok as [| | ? ? ? ? ? Θ1 Ξ1 ? lΘ Hg1 Hs1 Hl1 Ha HsT HT HΘ' Hargs HaΘ HRΘ |]; subst.
    exact (filed_apps_wf _ _ _ HΓ _ _ _ Hc Ha HsT HT _ Hargs).
  - inversion Hok as [| | ? ? ? ? ? Θ1 Ξ1 ? lΘ Hg1 Hs1 Hl1 Ha HsT HT HΘ' Hargs HaΘ HRΘ HLΘ |]; subst.
    destruct (params_evaluated_sorts _ _ _ _ _ HRΘ) as (ps & Hps & Hp).
    pose proof (filed_denote _ _ Hg _ _ _ ((e :: Θ') ++ Γ) Ns (gc_loc_of_loc _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hc)) as (R0 & HR0 & HRm0).
    (* the alias of the filed module: its flag from the outer parameters'
       of the description *)
    assert (HF : exists lv Rt, levels_flag Θ Ξ Γ (e :: Θ') (me_apps (qname_mod p) Ns) lv Rt).
    { destruct HLΘ as [HL | HN].
      - exists true, R0; constructor; [ intros _; exact HL | discriminate | discriminate ].
      - exists false, R0; constructor; [ discriminate | intros _; exact HR0 | intros _; exact (no_level_of_mod _ _ _ _ _ HRm0 HN) ]. }
    destruct HF as (lv & Rt & HF).
    apply Hlit; cbn; refine (mk_unit_alias_full _ _ _ _ _ lΘ ps Hps HΘ' HaΘ _ Hp lv Rt HF _).
    + exact (proj1 (filed_apps_wf _ _ _ HΘ' _ _ _ Hc Ha HsT HT _ Hargs)).
    + (* abstracted over outer parameters, the module is no open frame
         (desc_ok_closed) *)
      exists R0; split; [ exact HR0 |].
      intros (? & ? & ? & ? & ? & Hm' & Hf); rewrite HRm0 in Hm'; injection Hm' as _ <- _ _ _.
      match goal with HF0 : _ :: _ <> nil -> gc_frame _ _ = None |- _ => exact (Hf (HF0 ltac:(discriminate))) end.
Qed.

Lemma modexp_gen : forall Θ Ξ Γ H H', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> gen_m Θ Ξ Γ H /\ gen_m Θ Ξ Γ H'.
Proof.
  induction 1; cbn [gen_m]; try solve [ intuition eauto using wf_modexp_eq_refl_left, wf_modexp_eq_refl_right ].
  - exact (unit_full_of_eq _ _ _ _ _ H).
  - split; split; first [ eapply wf_modexp_eq_refl_left; eassumption | eapply wf_modexp_eq_refl_right; eassumption
                        | do 5 eexists; repeat split; eassumption ].
  - split; [ exact I | exact (proj1 (unit_full_of_eq _ _ _ _ _ (ctx_lookup_mod_wf _ _ _ _ _ H H0))) ].
  - (* a selection: the unit its module part stands for *)
    split; [ exact (proj1 IHwf_modexp_eq) |].
    pose proof (presup_modexp_eq_ctx H0) as HΓ; pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΓ) as Hg.
    exact (proj2 (mdesc_unit_wf _ _ _ _ HΓ (desc_ok_mod _ _ Hg _ _ _ (me_desc_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ H0 H1) H2)
                    (mdesc_canonical_mod _ _ _ _ (mdenote_canon _ _ _ _ _ Hg H1) H2) (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ H2)
                    (wf_mdenote_mod_xp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H0 H1 H2))).
  - destruct (gen_beta _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H H0) as [Hl Hr]; split; [ exact Hl |].
    rewrite gunit_sub_mk in Hr; exact Hr.
  - destruct (gen_beta _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H H0) as [Hl Hr]; split; [ exact Hl |].
    rewrite gunit_sub_mk in Hr; exact Hr.
  - split; [| exact (proj1 IHwf_modexp_eq) ].
    pose proof (presup_modexp_eq_ctx H0) as HΓ.
    cbn; refine (mk_unit_alias_full _ _ _ _ _ 0 (fun _ => Typeω@0) (fun _ => ltac:(constructor)) _ ltac:(constructor) H0
                   ltac:(intros [| ? ?] ? ? ? Heq; discriminate) true (mdesc_term ak_relevant Typeω@0 None) _ _); [ exact HΓ | |].
    + constructor; [ intros _ [| ? ?] ? ? ? Heq; discriminate | discriminate | discriminate ].
    + cbn [List.app]; assumption.
Qed.

Parts of Descriptions under Application


Lemma mdesc_ats_term : forall Ns r A om R', mdesc_ats (mdesc_term r A om) Ns = Some R' -> exists A' om', R' = mdesc_term r A' om'.
Proof.
  induction Ns as [| N Ns IH]; intros * Ha; cbn in Ha; [ injection Ha as <-; eauto |].
  destruct (pi_view A) as [[X C] |]; [| discriminate ].
  destruct om as [M |]; [ destruct (fn_view M) as [M' |]; [| discriminate ] |]; exact (IH _ _ _ _ Ha).
Qed.

The module part of "R at N" is the module part of R at N.
Lemma mdesc_mod_at : forall R Rm N R', mdesc_mod R = Some Rm -> mdesc_at R N = Some R' ->
    exists Rm', mdesc_at Rm N = Some Rm' /\ mdesc_mod R' = Some Rm'.
Proof.
  intros R; induction R as [| Δ Φ | Θ0 p T Φ Ns | Θd A M Rm0 IH];
    intros Rm N R' Hm Ha; cbn in Hm; try discriminate.
  3: { (* a definition with a module part: its module part *)
       cbn in Ha; destruct (mdesc_at Rm0 N) as [Rm0' |] eqn:E; [| discriminate ].
       destruct (IH _ _ _ Hm E) as (Rm' & Hat & Hm').
       destruct (tele_split (rev Θd)) as [[[? ?] ?] | ?]; injection Ha as <-; exists Rm'; split; assumption. }
  - injection Hm as <-; exists R'; split; [ exact Ha |].
    apply mdesc_is_mod_mod; eapply mdesc_at_is_mod; [| exact Ha ]; exact I.
  - injection Hm as <-; exists R'; split; [ exact Ha |].
    apply mdesc_is_mod_mod; eapply mdesc_at_is_mod; [| exact Ha ]; exact I.
Qed.

Lemma mdesc_mod_at_inv : forall R Rm N Rm', mdesc_mod R = Some Rm -> mdesc_at Rm N = Some Rm' ->
    exists R', mdesc_at R N = Some R' /\ mdesc_mod R' = Some Rm'.
Proof.
  intros R; induction R as [| Δ Φ | Θ0 p T Φ Ns | Θd A M Rm0 IH];
    intros Rm N Rm' Hm Ha; cbn in Hm; try discriminate.
  3: { (* a definition with a module part: its module part *)
       destruct (IH _ _ _ Hm Ha) as (R0' & Hat & Hm').
       cbn; rewrite Hat.
       destruct (tele_split (rev Θd)) as [[[? ?] ?] | ?]; eexists; split; first [ reflexivity | exact Hm' ]. }
  - injection Hm as <-; exists Rm'; split; [ exact Ha |].
    apply mdesc_is_mod_mod; eapply mdesc_at_is_mod; [| exact Ha ]; exact I.
  - injection Hm as <-; exists Rm'; split; [ exact Ha |].
    apply mdesc_is_mod_mod; eapply mdesc_at_is_mod; [| exact Ha ]; exact I.
Qed.

Lemma mdesc_mod_ats : forall Ns R Rm R', mdesc_mod R = Some Rm -> mdesc_ats R Ns = Some R' ->
    exists Rm', mdesc_ats Rm Ns = Some Rm' /\ mdesc_mod R' = Some Rm'.
Proof.
  induction Ns as [| N Ns IH]; intros * Hm Ha; cbn in Ha |- *; [ injection Ha as <-; eauto |].
  destruct (mdesc_at R N) as [R1 |] eqn:E; [| discriminate ].
  destruct (mdesc_mod_at _ _ _ _ Hm E) as (Rm1 & -> & Hm1).
  exact (IH _ _ _ Hm1 Ha).
Qed.

Lemma mdesc_mod_ats_inv : forall Ns R Rm Rm', mdesc_mod R = Some Rm -> mdesc_ats Rm Ns = Some Rm' ->
    exists R', mdesc_ats R Ns = Some R' /\ mdesc_mod R' = Some Rm'.
Proof.
  induction Ns as [| N Ns IH]; intros * Hm Ha; cbn in Ha |- *; [ injection Ha as <-; eauto |].
  destruct (mdesc_at Rm N) as [Rm1 |] eqn:E; [| discriminate ].
  destruct (mdesc_mod_at_inv _ _ _ _ Hm E) as (R1 & -> & Hm1).
  exact (IH _ _ _ Hm1 Ha).
Qed.

The module part of a description read at arguments (mdesc_ats_read) is its module part given them (mdesc_mod_ats): a definition with a module part gives them to its module part as a module.
Lemma mdesc_mod_ats_read : forall Ns R Rm R1, mdesc_mod R = Some Rm -> mdesc_ats_read R Ns = Some R1 ->
    exists Rm1, mdesc_ats Rm Ns = Some Rm1 /\ mdesc_mod R1 = Some Rm1.
Proof.
  intros * Hm Ha; destruct (mdesc_ats_read_inv _ _ _ Ha) as [Ha' | (A & M & Rm0 & r & B & M' & Rm' & -> & -> & _ & E)];
    [ exact (mdesc_mod_ats _ _ _ _ Hm Ha') |].
  cbn in Hm |- *; exact (mdesc_mod_ats _ _ _ _ Hm E).
Qed.

Lemma mdesc_reduct_up : forall Θ' R, mdesc_reduct (mdesc_up Θ' R) = option_map (ctx_fn Θ') (mdesc_reduct R).
Proof.
  intros; destruct R as [r A [M |] | | | Θd A M Rm]; cbn; try reflexivity;
    rewrite ctx_fn_app; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma mdesc_type_up_inv : forall Δ R A, mdesc_type (mdesc_up Δ R) = Some A ->
    exists A0, mdesc_type R = Some A0 /\ A = ctx_pi_at (mdesc_kind R) Δ A0.
Proof.
  intros * Ht; destruct R as [r A0 om | | | Θd A0 M0 Rm]; cbn in *; try discriminate.
  - injection Ht as <-; eauto.
  - injection Ht as <-; rewrite ctx_pi_app; eauto.
Qed.

Applied Module Expressions

A module expression denoting a description abstracted over Δa, given arguments for the outermost parameters of Δa, is well formed.
Lemma wf_apps_up : forall Θ Ξ Ns Γ Δa R H l,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H (mdesc_up Δa R) -> mdesc_is_mod R ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ++ Γ -> all_assumptions Δa -> length Ns <= length Δa ->
    (forall k N A, nth_error Ns k = Some N -> nth_error (tele_insts Δa Id Ns) k = Some A -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N : A) ->
    desc_ok Θ Ξ (Δa ++ Γ) R -> params_evaluated Θ Ξ Γ Δa l ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_apps H Ns ≈ me_apps H Ns.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ; induction Ns as [| N Ns IH]; intros * HH Hm Hmod HΔ Ha Hl HNs HR HRΔ; [ exact HH |].
  pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΔ) as Hg.
  destruct (List.exists_last (l := Δa)) as (Δ1 & e & ->); [ intros ->; cbn in Hl; lia |].
  unfold all_assumptions in Ha; apply List.Forall_app in Ha as [Ha1 He]; apply List.Forall_cons_iff in He as [(κ & C & ->) _].
  rewrite tele_insts_snoc in HNs.
  pose proof (HNs 0 N C[Id] eq_refl eq_refl) as HN; rewrite exp_sub_id in HN.
  (* the argument's type is relevant, as every parameter of a module *)
  destruct (params_evaluated_app_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ HRΔ) as [HRΔ1 HRC].
  pose proof (HRC nil κ C nil eq_refl) as HC0; cbn [List.app] in HC0, HRΔ1.
  destruct (param_typed_evaluated _ _ _ _ _ HC0) as (SC & HSC & HC).
  rewrite <- List.app_assoc in HΔ, HR; cbn [List.app] in HΔ, HR.
  destruct (ctx_decomp_sort_kind (ctx_app_wf_tail _ _ _ _ HΔ)) as [HΓ (SCκ & HSCκ & HCκ)].
  pose proof (wf_sub_single _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HCκ HSCκ HN) as Hs1.
  assert (HΔN : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub Δ1 (Id,,N) ++ Γ) by (eapply ctx_sub_wf_gen; eassumption).
  assert (Hσ : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub Δ1 (Id,,N) ++ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_qn (length Δ1) (Id,,N) : Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ C :: Γ)
    by (apply wf_sub_ext; assumption).
  destruct (desc_ok_tele _ _ _ _ HR Hmod) as (T0 & Ht0).
  assert (HHN : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_app H N ≈ me_app H N).
  { eapply wf_me_app; [ exact HH | exact Hm | | apply (tele_view_last (T0 ++ Δ1)) | exact HC | exact HSC | exact HN
                      | apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact HN | exact Hm | | apply (tele_view_last (T0 ++ Δ1)) | exact HC | exact HSC | exact HN ].
    all: unfold mdesc_mod_tele; rewrite (mdesc_is_mod_mod _ (mdesc_is_mod_up _ _ Hmod)), (mdesc_tele_up _ _ _ Ht0), app_assoc; reflexivity. }
  cbn [me_apps].
  eapply (IH Γ (tele_sub Δ1 (Id,,N)) (mdesc_sub R (sb_qn (length Δ1) (Id,,N)))).
  - exact HHN.
  - eapply mdenote_app; [ exact Hm | apply mdesc_at_up ].
  - apply mdesc_is_mod_sub; exact Hmod.
  - exact HΔN.
  - apply all_assumptions_sub; exact Ha1.
  - rewrite length_tele_sub; rewrite List.length_app in Hl; cbn in Hl; lia.
  - intros k N1 A HN1 HA.
    rewrite tele_insts_tele_sub, (tele_insts_sb_eq _ _ (Id,,N)) in HA by apply sb_compose_id_right.
    exact (HNs (S k) N1 A HN1 HA).
  - exact (desc_ok_sub _ _ Hg _ _ HR _ _ Hσ).
  - exact (params_evaluated_sub _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HRΔ1 Hs1 HΔ HΔN).
Qed.

β for a well-formed literal, its two forms in one.
Lemma beta_step : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ κ X D N,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_mk (Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) D ≈ gu_mk (Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) D -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N : X ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_app (me_lit (gu_mk (Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) D)) N ≈ me_lit (gu_mk Δ D)[Id,,N]ᵘ.
Proof.
  intros * HU HN; rewrite gunit_sub_mk.
  pose proof (proj1 (unit_full_of_eq _ _ _ _ _ HU)) as Hf.
  destruct D as [[] Φ | E]; cbn in Hf; try contradiction; cbn [moddef_sub].
  - apply wf_me_beta_body; assumption.
  - apply wf_me_beta_alias; assumption.
Qed.

Local Entries Filled in

A closed entry denotes the same anywhere.
Lemma edenote_closed_move : forall Θ Ξ Γ Γ' o E R σ, gctx_closed Θ Ξ -> entry_sc 0 E ->
    edenote Θ Ξ Γ o E R -> sub_mod_compat σ Γ' Γ -> edenote Θ Ξ Γ' o E R.
Proof.
  intros * Hc HE Hd Hσ.
  assert (HS : slots_ok 0 Γ) by (intros ? ? Hx; lia).
  pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (mdenote_scoped_all _ _ Hc))) _ _ _ _ Hd _ HS HE) as HR.
  pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (mdenote_sub_all _ _ Hc))) _ _ _ _ Hd _ HS HE _ _ Hσ) as Hd'.
  rewrite (mdesc_closed_sub _ _ HR) in Hd'.
  exact (edenote_closed_any _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HE Hd').
Qed.

Filed Modules at Arguments

A module expression is well formed at the arguments another one is, when at every prefix of them it takes a first parameter of the same type.
Lemma apps_transfer : forall Θ Ξ Γ Ns H H',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_apps H Ns ≈ me_apps H Ns -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H' ≈ H' ->
    (forall Ms Ms' R R' T B T1, Ns = Ms ++ Ms' -> Ms' <> nil ->
       mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_apps H Ms) R -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_apps H' Ms) R' ->
       mdesc_mod_tele R = Some T -> tele_view T = Some (B, T1) ->
       exists T' T1', mdesc_mod_tele R' = Some T' /\ tele_view T' = Some (B, T1')) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_apps H' Ns ≈ me_apps H' Ns.
Proof.
  intros * Hw HH'; induction Ns as [| N Ns IH] using List.rev_ind; intros Ht; [ exact HH' |].
  rewrite !me_apps_snoc in *.
  destruct (proj1 (modexp_gen _ _ _ _ _ Hw)) as (Hw0 & R & T & B & T1 & SB & Hm & HT & Hv & HB & HSB & HN); cbn [gen_m] in *.
  assert (IH' : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_apps H' Ns ≈ me_apps H' Ns).
  { apply IH; [ exact Hw0 |].
    intros * Heq Hne; apply (Ht Ms (Ms' ++ N :: nil)); [ rewrite Heq, app_assoc; reflexivity | destruct Ms'; [ contradiction | discriminate ] ]. }
  destruct (me_denotes _ _ _ _ _ IH') as (R' & _ & Hm' & _).
  destruct (Ht Ns (N :: nil) R R' T B T1 eq_refl ltac:(discriminate) Hm Hm' HT Hv) as (T' & T1' & HT' & Hv').
  eapply wf_me_app; [ exact IH' | exact Hm' | exact HT' | exact Hv' | exact HB | exact HSB | exact HN | apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact HN
                    | exact Hm' | exact HT' | exact Hv' | exact HB | exact HSB | exact HN ].
Qed.

What the telescope of a filed module at arguments is.
Lemma filed_apps_mtele : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall p T Φ Γ Ms R, gc_loc Θ Ξ p = Some (T, Φ) ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_apps (qname_mod p) Ms) R -> mdesc_mod_tele R = mdesc_tele (mdesc_closed nil p T Φ Ms).
Proof.
  intros * Hg * Hgl Hm.
  destruct (filed_denote _ _ Hg _ _ _ Γ Ms Hgl) as (R0 & Hm0 & Hmod0).
  rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm _ Hm0).
  unfold mdesc_mod_tele; rewrite Hmod0; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma tele_view_app_r : forall X Y B Y1, tele_view Y = Some (B, Y1) -> exists Y1', tele_view (X ++ Y) = Some (B, Y1').
Proof.
  intros * Hv; unfold tele_view in *; rewrite rev_app_distr.
  destruct (tele_open_split _ _ _ Hv) as (τ & Hs).
  exact (tele_open_app_inl _ _ _ _ _ Hs).
Qed.

A filed module whose telescope ends in another's takes the same first parameter at the same arguments.
Lemma mdesc_tele_closed_ext : forall p T Φ pq Δ0 Φ' Ms T0 B T1,
    mdesc_tele (mdesc_closed nil p T Φ Ms) = Some T0 -> tele_view T0 = Some (B, T1) ->
    exists T0' T1', mdesc_tele (mdesc_closed nil pq (Δ0 ++ T) Φ' Ms) = Some T0' /\ tele_view T0' = Some (B, T1').
Proof.
  intros * Ht Hv; cbn in Ht |- *.
  destruct (Nat.leb (length Ms) (length T)) eqn:Hl; [ injection Ht as <- | discriminate ].
  apply Nat.leb_le in Hl.
  replace (Nat.leb (length Ms) (length (Δ0 ++ T))) with true by (symmetry; apply Nat.leb_le; rewrite length_app; lia).
  replace (length (Δ0 ++ T) - length Ms) with (length Δ0 + (length T - length Ms)) by (rewrite length_app; lia).
  rewrite List.firstn_app, List.firstn_all2 by lia.
  replace (length Δ0 + (length T - length Ms) - length Δ0) with (length T - length Ms) by lia.
  rewrite tele_sub_app; rewrite ?List.app_nil_r in Hv |- *.
  destruct (tele_view_app_r (tele_sub Δ0 (sb_qn (length (firstn (length T - length Ms) T)) (sb_of_list Id Ms))) _ _ _ Hv) as (T1' & Hv').
  eauto.
Qed.

Lemma filed_apps_ext : forall Θ Ξ Γ p T Φ pq Δ0 Φ' Ns, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ ->
    gc_loc Θ Ξ p = Some (T, Φ) -> gc_loc Θ Ξ pq = Some (Δ0 ++ T, Φ') ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_apps (qname_mod p) Ns ≈ me_apps (qname_mod p) Ns ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ qname_mod pq ≈ qname_mod pq ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_apps (qname_mod pq) Ns ≈ me_apps (qname_mod pq) Ns.
Proof.
  intros * Hg Hp Hq Hw Hw'.
  apply (apps_transfer _ _ _ _ _ _ Hw Hw').
  intros * _ _ Hm Hm' Ht Hv.
  rewrite (filed_apps_mtele _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ Hp Hm) in Ht.
  rewrite (filed_apps_mtele _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq Hm').
  exact (mdesc_tele_closed_ext _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ht Hv).
Qed.

A module expression over a closed telescope is well formed on top of any context.
Lemma modexp_tele_weaken : forall Θ Ξ Δa Γ E E',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ⊢ᵐ E ≈ E' -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ++ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ E ≈ E'.
Proof.
  intros * HE HΓ.
  pose proof (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HE) as HΔ.
  pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΔ) as Hg.
  pose proof (wf_ctx_scoped _ _ _ HΔ) as Hs.
  destruct (wf_modexp_eq_scoped _ _ _ _ _ HE) as (_ & HsE & HsE').
  pose proof (ctx_app_wf_tail _ _ _ _ HΓ) as HΓ0.
  assert (Hw : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ ι (wk_shiftn (length Γ)) : ⋅).
  { apply wf_sub_of_wk; rewrite <- (List.app_nil_r Γ) at 1; apply wf_wk_shiftn_app;
      [ rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact HΓ0 | constructor; exact Hg ]. }
  assert (Hσ : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ++ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_qn (length Δa) (ι (wk_shiftn (length Γ))) : Δa ++ ⋅).
  { pose proof (wf_sub_ext _ _ Δa _ _ _ Hw) as Hx; rewrite tele_sub_closed in Hx by exact Hs.
    apply Hx; [ exact HΓ | rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact HΔ ]. }
  rewrite List.app_nil_r in Hσ.
  pose proof (sub_preserves_modexp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HE Hσ) as HE2.
  assert (Hfix : forall x, x < length Δa -> sb_qn (length Δa) (ι (wk_shiftn (length Γ))) x = se_var x)
    by (intros x Hx; apply (sb_qn_fix _ _ 0); [ intros; lia | lia ]).
  rewrite (proj1 (proj2 syn_scoped_sub_id) _ _ _ HsE Hfix), (proj1 (proj2 syn_scoped_sub_id) _ _ _ HsE' Hfix) in HE2.
  exact HE2.
Qed.

A δ-reduct Applied

A term equal to a δ-reduct abstracted over Δa, applied to arguments for the outermost parameters of Δa, is equal to the δ-reduct the description reads at the arguments, by β.
Lemma ats_up_red_eq : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall Ns Γ Δa R M M0 A0,
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ++ Γ -> all_assumptions Δa -> length Ns <= length Δa ->
    (forall k N A, nth_error Ns k = Some N -> nth_error (tele_insts Δa Id Ns) k = Some A -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N : A) ->
    mdesc_type R = Some A0 -> mdesc_reduct R = Some M0 ->
    
The type is of the sort of the description's kind; of a type of levels only over parameters of types of levels
    (exists i, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ++ Γ ⊢ A0 : abs_kind_sort (mdesc_kind R) Typeω@i) ->
    (mdesc_kind R = ak_level -> level_sorted_parameters Δa) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δa ++ Γ ⊢ M0 : A0 ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ ctx_fn Δa M0 : ctx_pi_at (mdesc_kind R) Δa A0 ->
    exists R' A' M', mdesc_ats (mdesc_up Δa R) Ns = Some R' /\ mdesc_type R' = Some A' /\ mdesc_reduct R' = Some M' /\
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ apps M Ns ≈ M' : A'.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg; pose proof (wf_gstack_closed _ _ Hg) as Hc.
  induction Ns as [| N Ns IH]; intros * HΔ Ha Hl HNs Ht Hr [i HA0] HL HM0 HM.
  - exists (mdesc_up Δa R), (ctx_pi_at (mdesc_kind R) Δa A0), (ctx_fn Δa M0).
    split; [ reflexivity |]; split; [ apply mdesc_type_up; exact Ht |]; split; [ rewrite mdesc_reduct_up, Hr; reflexivity | exact HM ].
  - destruct (List.exists_last (l := Δa)) as (Δ1 & e & ->); [ intros ->; cbn in Hl; lia |].
    unfold all_assumptions in Ha; apply List.Forall_app in Ha as [Ha1 He]; apply List.Forall_cons_iff in He as [(κ & C & ->) _].
    rewrite tele_insts_snoc in HNs.
    pose proof (HNs 0 N C[Id] eq_refl eq_refl) as HN; rewrite exp_sub_id in HN.
    (* with a codomain of levels, the parameters are of levels *)
    assert (HL' : mdesc_kind R = ak_level -> level_sorted_parameters Δ1 /\ κ = ak_level).
    { intros Hk; destruct (level_sorted_app_inv _ _ (HL Hk)) as [H1 H2].
      split; [ exact H1 | exact (H2 nil κ C nil eq_refl) ]. }
    rewrite <- List.app_assoc in HΔ, HA0, HM0; cbn [List.app] in HΔ, HA0, HM0.
    destruct (ctx_decomp_sort_kind (ctx_app_wf_tail _ _ _ _ HΔ)) as [HΓ (SC & HSC & HC)].
    pose proof (wf_sub_single _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HC HSC HN) as Hs1.
    assert (HΔN : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub Δ1 (Id,,N) ++ Γ) by (eapply ctx_sub_wf_gen; eassumption).
    assert (Hσ : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub Δ1 (Id,,N) ++ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_qn (length Δ1) (Id,,N) : Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ C :: Γ)
      by (apply wf_sub_ext; assumption).
    (* the Π over the rest and its λ, at the description's kind *)
    destruct (ctx_pi_type_kind _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΔ (fun _ => Ha1) (fun Hk => proj1 (HL' Hk)) HA0) as [[k HB] HFn].
    pose proof (HFn _ HM0) as HF.
    assert (Hk : pi_kinds κ (mdesc_kind R))
      by (destruct (mdesc_kind R) eqn:Er; [ constructor | constructor | destruct (HL' eq_refl) as [_ ->]; constructor ]).
    set (r := mdesc_kind R) in *.
    rewrite ctx_pi_app, ctx_fn_app in HM; cbn [ctx_pi_at ctx_fn] in HM.
    assert (HMN : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M $ N ≈ (ctx_fn Δ1 M0)[Id,,N] : (ctx_pi_at r Δ1 A0)[Id,,N]).
    { eapply wf_exp_eq_trans.
      - eapply wf_exp_eq_app_cong with (i := k); [ exact HC | exact HSC | exact HB | exact Hk | exact HM | apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact HN ].
      - eapply wf_exp_eq_pi_beta with (i := k); [ exact HC | exact HSC | exact HB | exact Hk | exact HF | exact HN ]. }
    rewrite ctx_pi_sub, ctx_fn_sub in HMN.
    cbn [mdesc_ats]; rewrite mdesc_at_up.
    apply (IH Γ (tele_sub Δ1 (Id,,N)) _ (M $ N) M0[sb_qn (length Δ1) (Id,,N)] A0[sb_qn (length Δ1) (Id,,N)]).
    + exact HΔN.
    + apply all_assumptions_sub; exact Ha1.
    + rewrite length_tele_sub; rewrite List.length_app in Hl; cbn in Hl; lia.
    + intros k0 N1 A HN1 HA.
      rewrite tele_insts_tele_sub, (tele_insts_sb_eq _ _ (Id,,N)) in HA by apply sb_compose_id_right.
      exact (HNs (S k0) N1 A HN1 HA).
    + apply mdesc_type_sub; exact Ht.
    + apply mdesc_reduct_sub; exact Hr.
    + exists i; subst r; rewrite mdesc_kind_sub.
      pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA0 Hσ) as HAσ.
      rewrite type_sort_sub in HAσ by (apply type_sort_abs_kind; constructor); exact HAσ.
    + subst r; rewrite mdesc_kind_sub; intros Hk'; exact (level_sorted_parameters_sub _ _ (proj1 (HL' Hk'))).
    + exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM0 Hσ).
    + subst r; rewrite mdesc_kind_sub; exact HMN.
Qed.

Equal terms of a Π over a telescope, applied to the same arguments.
Lemma wf_apps_ctx_pi_eq_n : forall n Θ Ξ Δ Γ B i M M' Ms,
    List.length Δ = n ->
    all_assumptions Δ -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ B : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : ctx_pi Δ B ->
    List.length Ms = List.length Δ ->
    (forall k N T, List.nth_error Ms k = Some N -> List.nth_error (tele_insts Δ Id Ms) k = Some T -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N : T) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ apps M Ms ≈ apps M' Ms : B[sb_of_list Id Ms].
Proof.
  induction n as [| n IH]; intros * Hn Hass HΔ HB HM Hl HMs.
  - destruct Δ; [| discriminate ]; destruct Ms; [| discriminate ]; cbn; rewrite exp_sub_id; exact HM.
  - destruct (List.exists_last (l := Δ)) as (Δ0 & e & ->); [ intros ->; discriminate |].
    rename Δ0 into Δ.
    rewrite List.length_app in Hn; cbn in Hn.
    unfold all_assumptions in Hass; apply List.Forall_app in Hass as [Hass He]; apply List.Forall_cons_iff in He as [(κ & A0 & ->) _].
    rewrite List.length_app in Hl; cbn in Hl.
    destruct Ms as [| M0 Ms]; [ cbn in Hl; lia |]; cbn in Hl.
    rewrite ctx_pi_snoc in HM; rewrite <- List.app_assoc in HΔ, HB; cbn [List.app] in HΔ, HB.
    destruct (ctx_decomp_sort_kind (ctx_app_wf_tail _ _ _ _ HΔ)) as [HΓ (SA & HSA & HA0)].
    destruct (ctx_pi_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ HΔ HB) as [j HPi].
    assert (HM0 : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M0 : A0)
      by (rewrite <- (exp_sub_id A0); apply (HMs 0); [ reflexivity | rewrite tele_insts_snoc; reflexivity ]).
    assert (Happ : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M $ M0 ≈ M' $ M0 : (ctx_pi Δ B)[Id,,M0])
      by (eapply wf_exp_eq_app_cong with (i := j) (κc := ak_relevant); [ exact HA0 | exact HSA | exact HPi | constructor | exact HM | apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact HM0 ]).
    rewrite ctx_pi_sub in Happ.
    pose proof (wf_sub_single _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA0 HSA HM0) as Hs.
    assert (HΔ' : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub Δ (Id,,M0) ++ Γ) by (eapply ctx_sub_wf; eassumption).
    pose proof (wf_sub_ext _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs HΔ' HΔ) as Hs'.
    cbn [apps_exp sb_of_list].
    replace (B[sb_of_list (Id,,M0) Ms]) with (B[sb_qn (List.length Δ) (Id,,M0)][sb_of_list Id Ms])
      by (replace (List.length Δ) with (List.length Ms) by lia; apply exp_sub_qn_of_list).
    eapply (IH _ _ (tele_sub Δ (Id,,M0))); [ rewrite length_tele_sub; lia | apply all_assumptions_sub; exact Hass | exact HΔ' | | exact Happ
               | rewrite length_tele_sub; lia |].
    + exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HB Hs').
    + intros k' N T HN HT; apply (HMs (S k')); [ exact HN |].
      rewrite tele_insts_snoc; cbn [List.nth_error].
      rewrite tele_insts_tele_sub in HT; rewrite <- HT; f_equal.
      apply tele_insts_sb_eq; symmetry; apply sb_compose_id_right.
Qed.

Equal terms of the type of an inductive type's type former, applied to arguments for its first uniform parameters.
Lemma wf_ind_args_eq : forall Θ Ξ Γ D k Mk Ns M M',
    decl_typed Θ Ξ D -> ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> args_ok Θ Ξ Γ (ind_uparams D) Ns ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : ind_ty_at D Mk nil -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ apps M Ns ≈ apps M' Ns : ind_ty_at D Mk Ns.
Proof.
  intros * HD Hk HΓ [T1 T2 HT Hlen Ha Hs HT2 HN] HM0.
  destruct (member_sort_typed _ _ _ _ _ HD Hk) as ([i Hi] & _).
  pose proof (member_params_wf _ _ _ _ _ HD Hk) as HP.
  assert (Hp : im_params D Mk = (im_nparams Mk ++ T1) ++ T2) by (unfold im_params; rewrite HT, List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
  rewrite Hp in Hi, HP.
  destruct (ctx_pi_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ HP Hi) as [j HB].
  pose proof (closed_tele_weaken_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs HB HT2) as HB'.
  assert (Hat : ind_ty_at D Mk Ns = (ctx_pi (im_nparams Mk ++ T1) (ind_sort D)[wk_shiftn (im_nn Mk)]ʷ)[sb_of_list Id Ns]).
  { unfold ind_ty_at; rewrite <- length_im_params, Hp.
    replace (length ((im_nparams Mk ++ T1) ++ T2) - length Ns) with (length (im_nparams Mk ++ T1))
      by (rewrite !List.length_app in *; lia).
    rewrite List.firstn_app, List.firstn_all, Nat.sub_diag; cbn [List.firstn]; rewrite List.app_nil_r; reflexivity. }
  assert (HM : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : ctx_pi T2 (ctx_pi (im_nparams Mk ++ T1) (ind_sort D)[wk_shiftn (im_nn Mk)]ʷ)).
  { rewrite <- ctx_pi_app, <- Hp.
    unfold ind_ty_at in HM0; rewrite <- length_im_params, Nat.sub_0_r, List.firstn_all in HM0; cbn [sb_of_list List.length] in HM0.
    rewrite exp_sub_id in HM0; exact HM0. }
  rewrite Hat; eapply wf_apps_ctx_pi_eq_n; [ reflexivity | exact Ha | exact HT2 | exact HB' | exact HM | symmetry; exact Hlen | exact HN ].
Qed.

Equal terms of the type of a record's type former, applied to arguments for its outermost parameters.
Lemma wf_record_args_eq : forall Θ Ξ Γ R Ns M M',
    record_typed Θ Ξ R -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> args_ok Θ Ξ Γ (record_params R) Ns ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : record_ty_at R nil -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ apps M Ns ≈ apps M' Ns : record_ty_at R Ns.
Proof.
  intros * HR HΓ [T1 T2 HT Hlen Ha Hs HT2 HN] HM0.
  pose proof HR as [_ _ HSu _ _].
  destruct (wf_is_univ_typ HSu) as [i Hi].
  pose proof (presup_is_univ_ctx HSu) as HP.
  rewrite HT in Hi, HP.
  destruct (ctx_pi_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ HP Hi) as [j HB].
  pose proof (closed_tele_weaken_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs HB HT2) as HB'.
  assert (Hat : record_ty_at R Ns = (ctx_pi T1 (record_sort R))[sb_of_list Id Ns]).
  { unfold record_ty_at; rewrite HT.
    replace (length (T1 ++ T2) - length Ns) with (length T1) by (rewrite List.length_app; lia).
    rewrite List.firstn_app, List.firstn_all, Nat.sub_diag; cbn [List.firstn]; rewrite List.app_nil_r; reflexivity. }
  assert (HM : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : ctx_pi T2 (ctx_pi T1 (record_sort R))).
  { rewrite <- ctx_pi_app, <- HT.
    unfold record_ty_at in HM0; rewrite Nat.sub_0_r, List.firstn_all in HM0; cbn [sb_of_list List.length] in HM0.
    rewrite exp_sub_id in HM0; exact HM0. }
  rewrite Hat; eapply wf_apps_ctx_pi_eq_n; [ reflexivity | exact Ha | exact HT2 | exact HB' | exact HM | symmetry; exact Hlen | exact HN ].
Qed.

A Member of a Filed Module at Arguments

(P N⃗).x ≈ P.x N⃗, for every term entry x of a filed module P: a filed axiom or abstract definition by δ to its name, a transparent definition by δ on both sides and β, an inductive type and an inductive alias by δ on both sides to the type former.
Theorem mem_filed_apps : forall Θ Ξ Γ p T Φ Ns x R A,
    gc_loc Θ Ξ p = Some (T, Φ) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_apps (qname_mod p) Ns ≈ me_apps (qname_mod p) Ns ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem (me_apps (qname_mod p) Ns) x) R -> mdesc_type R = Some A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_mem (me_apps (qname_mod p) Ns) x ≈ apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns : A.
Proof.
  intros * Hgl Hw Hm Ht.
  pose proof (presup_modexp_eq_ctx Hw) as HΓ; pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΓ) as Hg.
  pose proof (gctx_valid_syn _ _ Hg) as Hv.
  pose proof (gc_loc_loc _ _ _ _ _ Hgl) as Hl.
  inversion Hm as [? ? ? ? ? Hq Hu | ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? Hq Hk | | | | ? ? ? R0 R0m Γy E rd Re ? Hm0 Hmd He Hed Hr
                  | ? ? ? ? ? ? Hq Hk];
    subst.
  { cbn in Ht; discriminate. }
  { (* an open frame of a member's module: no arguments, both sides alike *)
    destruct Ns as [| N Ns'] using List.rev_ind; [ apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact (wf_mem_desc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hw Hm Ht) |].
    rewrite me_apps_snoc in Hq; discriminate. }
  2: { (* an open frame of a record's module: no arguments, both sides alike *)
    destruct Ns as [| N Ns'] using List.rev_ind; [ apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact (wf_mem_desc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hw Hm Ht) |].
    rewrite me_apps_snoc in Hq; discriminate. }
  destruct (filed_denote _ _ Hg _ _ _ Γ Ns Hgl) as (R0' & Hm0' & Hmd').
  rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm0 _ Hm0'), Hmd' in Hmd; injection Hmd as <-.
  pose proof (desc_ok_mod _ _ Hg _ _ _ (me_desc_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ Hw Hm0') Hmd') as HokP.
  inversion HokP as [| | ? ? ? ? ? Θ1 Ξ1 ? lΘ Hg1 Hs1 Hl1 HaT HsT HT HΘ' Hargs HaΘ HRΘ |]; subst; cbn [List.app] in Hargs.
  cbn in He, Hed; destruct (gm_prefix_upto Φ x) as [[| Φ0 y E0 | ? ? ?] |] eqn:Hp; try discriminate.
  injection He as <- <- <-.
  destruct (gm_prefix_entry _ _ _ Hp) as (? & ? & [= <- <- <-] & Hent).
  (* the filed member itself, its lookup from the same entry *)
  destruct (filed_denote _ _ Hg _ _ _ Γ nil (gc_loc_of_loc _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl)) as (Rp & Hmp & Hmdp); cbn [me_apps] in Hmp.
  assert (Hmx : mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem (qname_mod p) y) (mdesc_up nil Re))
    by (eapply mdenote_mem; [ exact Hmp | exact Hmdp | cbn; rewrite Hp; reflexivity | exact Hed
                       | cbn [mdesc_read]; rewrite mdesc_ats_read_nil; reflexivity ]).
  pose proof (loc_modexp_wf _ _ _ HΓ _ _ _ Hl) as HwP.
  destruct (loc_valid _ _ _ _ _ Hv Hl) as [_ HvΦ].
  pose proof (gm_valid_prefix _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HvΦ Hp) as HE0.
  pose proof (gm_coherent_prefix _ _ _ _ _ (loc_coherent _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl) Hp) as HcE0.
  pose proof (loc_closed _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl) as [_ HcΦ].
  pose proof (body_closed_prefix _ _ _ _ HcΦ Hp) as HcE; cbn in HcE; destruct HcE as [_ HcE].
  pose proof (closed_tele_wf _ _ _ _ HsT HT HΓ) as HTΓ.
  cbn [mdesc_read] in Hr; destruct (mdesc_ats_read Re Ns) as [R1 |] eqn:Hats; cbn [option_map] in Hr; [ injection Hr as <- | discriminate ].
  (* a term part with a module part, of a body typed under T: as a
     transparent definition, δ on both sides, then β *)
  match goal with |- ?G =>
    assert (Hdm : forall A0 M0 Rm, Re = mdesc_dm nil (ctx_pi T A0) (ctx_fn T M0) Rm ->
              (exists i, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ T ++ Γ ⊢ A0 : Typeω@i) -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ T ++ Γ ⊢ M0 : A0 -> G) end.
  { intros A0 M0 Rm -> [i HA0i] HM.
    cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats.
    change (mdesc_term ak_relevant (ctx_pi T A0) (Some (ctx_fn T M0))) with (mdesc_up T (mdesc_term ak_relevant A0 (Some M0))) in Hats.
    rewrite (mdesc_term_part_ats_up _ _ _ _ _ HaT (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ Hargs)) in Hats; cbn [mdesc_up option_map] in Hats.
    destruct (mdesc_ats (mdesc_term ak_relevant (ctx_pi T A0) (Some (ctx_fn T M0))) Ns) as [[? B [M1 |] | | |] |] eqn:HtA;
      try discriminate.
    destruct (mdesc_ats Rm Ns) as [Rm' |] eqn:HRm; [ injection Hats as <- | discriminate ].
    rewrite mdesc_named_fix in Hm, Ht by reflexivity.
    assert (Hδx : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_mem (qname_mod p) y ≈ ctx_fn T M0 : ctx_pi T A0)
      by (eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_delta; [ exact HwP | exact Hmx | reflexivity | reflexivity ]).
    destruct (ats_up_red_eq _ _ Hg Ns Γ T (mdesc_term ak_relevant A0 (Some M0)) (a_mem (qname_mod p) y) M0 A0 HTΓ HaT
                (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ Hargs) (args_ok_insts _ _ _ _ _ Hargs) eq_refl eq_refl
                (ex_intro _ i HA0i) ltac:(intros Hk; discriminate Hk) HM Hδx)
      as (R' & A'' & M' & Hats' & Ht' & Hr' & Heq).
    cbn [mdesc_up option_map] in Hats'; rewrite HtA in Hats'; injection Hats' as <-.
    cbn [mdesc_up mdesc_type mdesc_reduct List.app ctx_pi ctx_fn] in Ht, Ht', Hr'; injection Ht as <-; injection Ht' as <-; injection Hr' as <-.
    eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [ eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_delta; [ exact Hw | exact Hm | reflexivity | reflexivity ] |].
    apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Heq. }
  destruct E0 as [b pv ra A' oM | pv [Δ [sm Φy | E'] ] | pv pq kq D ΦD | pv Ad Md Ud | pv pr Rr ΦR ].
  - (* a definition, of either tag *)
    cbn in HE0; destruct HE0 as (A0 & -> & [lA HLsrt HA0] & HM0).
    cbn [ge_read] in Hed; inversion Hed; subst; cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats.
    assert (Hnone : forall Ns0 A1 R2, mdesc_ats (mdesc_term ra A1 None) Ns0 = Some R2 -> exists A2, R2 = mdesc_term ra A2 None).
    { induction Ns0 as [| N0 Ns0 IHN]; intros * Ha0; cbn in Ha0; [ injection Ha0 as <-; eauto |].
      destruct (pi_view A1) as [[? ?] |]; [ exact (IHN _ _ Ha0) | discriminate ]. }
    destruct b; [ destruct oM as [M |] |].
    + (* transparent: δ on both sides, then β *)
      destruct (HM0 M eq_refl) as (M0 & -> & HM).
      assert (Hδx : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_mem (qname_mod p) y ≈ ctx_fn T M0 : ctx_pi_at ra T A0)
        by (eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_delta; [ exact HwP | exact Hmx | reflexivity | reflexivity ]).
      destruct (ats_up_red_eq _ _ Hg Ns Γ T (mdesc_term ra A0 (Some M0)) (a_mem (qname_mod p) y) M0 A0 HTΓ HaT
                  (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ Hargs) (args_ok_insts _ _ _ _ _ Hargs) eq_refl eq_refl
                  (ex_intro _ lA (closed_tele_weaken_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ HsT HA0 HTΓ)) HLsrt
                  (closed_tele_weaken_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ HsT HM HTΓ) Hδx)
        as (R' & A'' & M' & Hats' & Ht' & Hr' & Heq).
      cbn [mdesc_up option_map] in Hats'; rewrite Hats in Hats'; injection Hats' as <-.
      destruct (mdesc_ats_some_red _ _ _ _ _ Hats) as (A1 & M1 & ->).
      rewrite mdesc_named_fix in Hm, Ht by reflexivity.
      cbn in Ht, Ht', Hr'; injection Ht as <-; injection Ht' as <-; injection Hr' as <-.
      eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [ eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_delta; [ exact Hw | exact Hm | reflexivity | reflexivity ] |].
      apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Heq.
    + (* an axiom: its name, at arguments; read bare, itself *)
      destruct (Hnone _ _ _ Hats) as (A1 & ->); destruct Ns as [| N Ns'].
      * apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact (wf_mem_desc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hw Hm Ht).
      * rewrite mdesc_named_self in Ht, Hm by (right; discriminate); cbn in Ht; injection Ht as <-.
        eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_delta; [ exact Hw | exact Hm | reflexivity | reflexivity ].
    + (* abstract: likewise *)
      destruct (Hnone _ _ _ Hats) as (A1 & ->); destruct Ns as [| N Ns'].
      * apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact (wf_mem_desc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hw Hm Ht).
      * rewrite mdesc_named_self in Ht, Hm by (right; discriminate); cbn in Ht; injection Ht as <-.
        eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_delta; [ exact Hw | exact Hm | reflexivity | reflexivity ].
  - (* a body module is no term *)
    assert (Hmm : mdesc_is_mod Re) by (destruct sm; cbn [ge_read] in Hed; inversion Hed; subst; eapply udenote_is_mod; eassumption).
    rewrite mdesc_ats_read_mod in Hats by exact Hmm.
    pose proof (mdesc_ats_is_mod _ _ _ Hmm Hats) as Hm1.
    destruct R1; cbn in Hm1; try contradiction; rewrite mdesc_named_fix in Ht by reflexivity; cbn in Ht; discriminate.
  - (* nor is an alias *)
    assert (Hmm : mdesc_is_mod Re) by (cbn [ge_read] in Hed; inversion Hed; subst; eapply udenote_is_mod; eassumption).
    rewrite mdesc_ats_read_mod in Hats by exact Hmm.
    pose proof (mdesc_ats_is_mod _ _ _ Hmm Hats) as Hm1.
    destruct R1; cbn in Hm1; try contradiction; rewrite mdesc_named_fix in Ht by reflexivity; cbn in Ht; discriminate.
  - (* an inductive type: the type former, δ on both sides, at the
       arguments *)
    cbn [ge_read] in Hed; inversion Hed as [| | ? ? ? ? ? ? ? Mk pm Tm Φm HMk Hpm Hlm | |]; subst.
    destruct HcE0 as ((Δ0 & HΔ0 & _) & _).
    pose proof (proj2 (loc_entry _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl _ _) Hent) as HeΘ.
    destruct (gc_entry_ind _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HeΘ) as [_ Hml].
    pose proof (ind_mlookup_group _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ Hml) as Hl0.
    pose proof (ind_lookup_valid _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (proj1 Hv) (proj2 Hv) Hl0) as HD; cbn [syn_VD] in HD.
    pose proof (decl_closed_ass _ (gctx_closed_ind _ _ _ _ (wf_gstack_closed _ _ Hg) Hl0)) as HaU.
    assert (HargsU : args_ok Θ Ξ Γ (ind_uparams D) Ns) by (rewrite HΔ0; apply args_ok_ext; exact Hargs).
    unfold ind_former_desc in Hats; cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats.
    rewrite (mdesc_term_part_ats_ind _ _ _ _ _ HaU (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ HargsU)), mdesc_ats_closed_nil in Hats; cbn in Hats.
    injection Hats as <-.
    rewrite mdesc_named_fix in Ht, Hm by reflexivity; cbn in Ht; injection Ht as <-.
    assert (Hδx : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_mem (qname_mod p) y ≈ a_ind pq kq : ind_ty_at D Mk nil)
      by (rewrite ind_ty_at_nil; eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_delta; [ exact HwP | exact Hmx | reflexivity | reflexivity ]).
    pose proof (wf_ind_args_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HD HMk HΓ HargsU Hδx) as Heq.
    eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [ eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_delta; [ exact Hw | exact Hm | reflexivity | reflexivity ] |].
    apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Heq.
  - (* a definition with a module part: its term part *)
    cbn [ge_read] in Hed; inversion Hed; subst.
    cbn [ge_valid syn_V] in HE0; destruct HE0 as (_ & (A0 & -> & _ & HM0) & (A1 & i & HA1 & HA0)).
    (* its term part's type is of a universe (wf_gentry_def_mod) *)
    pose proof (ctx_pi_at_ass_injective _ _ _ _ HaT HA1) as <-.
    destruct (HM0 _ eq_refl) as (M0 & -> & HM).
    exact (Hdm _ _ _ eq_refl (ex_intro _ i (closed_tele_weaken_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ HsT HA0 HTΓ))
             (closed_tele_weaken_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ HsT HM HTΓ)).
  - (* a record type: the type former, δ on both sides, at the
       arguments *)
    cbn [ge_read] in Hed; inversion Hed as [| | | | ? ? ? ? ? ? Tm Φm Hlm]; subst.
    pose proof (proj2 (loc_entry _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl _ _) Hent) as HeΘ.
    destruct HcE0 as ((Δ0 & HΔ0 & _) & _).
    assert (Hrl : record_lookup Θ Ξ (qname_in p y) = Some Rr)
      by (unfold record_lookup; rewrite (gc_entry_record_frame_none _ _ _ _ HeΘ), HeΘ; reflexivity).
    pose proof (record_lookup_typed _ _ Hg Hv _ _ Hrl) as HRt.
    assert (HargsP : args_ok Θ Ξ Γ (record_params Rr) Ns) by (rewrite HΔ0; apply args_ok_ext; exact Hargs).
    unfold record_former_desc in Hats; cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats.
    rewrite (mdesc_term_part_ats_record _ _ _ (typed_params_ass _ _ _ HRt) (args_ok_length _ _ _ _ _ HargsP)), mdesc_ats_closed_nil in Hats;
      cbn in Hats; injection Hats as <-.
    rewrite mdesc_named_fix in Ht, Hm by reflexivity; cbn in Ht; injection Ht as <-.
    assert (Hδx : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_mem (qname_mod p) y ≈ a_record (qname_in p y) : record_ty_at Rr nil)
      by (rewrite record_ty_at_nil; eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_delta; [ exact HwP | exact Hmx | reflexivity | reflexivity ]).
    pose proof (wf_record_args_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HRt HΓ HargsP Hδx) as Heq.
    eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [ eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_delta; [ exact Hw | exact Hm | reflexivity | reflexivity ] |].
    apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Heq.
Qed.

Members of Module Expressions with One Module Part

Every term a module expression looks up has a δ-reduct, so two module expressions whose module parts agree have equal members: A.x ≈ P.x for module A := P.
Lemma mem_same_lookup : forall Θ Ξ Γ H H' x R A M,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H' ≈ H' ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H x) R -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H' x) R -> mdesc_type R = Some A -> mdesc_reduct R = Some M ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_mem H x ≈ a_mem H' x : A.
Proof.
  intros * HH HH' Hm Hm' Ht Hr.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [ eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_delta; eassumption |].
  apply wf_exp_eq_sym; eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_delta; eassumption.
Qed.

A term read from a closed module part has a δ-reduct.
Lemma mdesc_reduct_closed_read : forall Θ' M R1 A, mdesc_type (mdesc_up Θ' (mdesc_self M R1)) = Some A ->
    exists M', mdesc_reduct (mdesc_up Θ' (mdesc_self M R1)) = Some M'.
Proof. intros * Ht; destruct R1 as [? ? [] | | |]; cbn in Ht |- *; try discriminate; eauto. Qed.

Equal bodies over a telescope of assumptions, abstracted over it at the kind r of their type; into a type of levels, over parameters of types of levels.
Lemma ctx_fn_eq : forall Θ Ξ r Δ Γ A M M' i, all_assumptions Δ -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ->
    (r = ak_level -> level_sorted_parameters Δ) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ ctx_fn Δ M ≈ ctx_fn Δ M' : ctx_pi_at r Δ A.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ r.
  induction Δ as [| [κ B | B N | U | B N U] Δ IH]; intros * Ha HΔ HL HA HM; cbn in *; [ assumption | | | |];
    inversion Ha as [| ? ? (? & ? & Heq) Ha']; subst; try discriminate.
  injection Heq as <- <-.
  destruct (ctx_decomp_sort_kind HΔ) as [HΔ0 (Srt & HS & HB)].
  (* with a codomain of levels, the parameter is of levels *)
  assert (HL' : r = ak_level -> level_sorted_parameters Δ /\ κ = ak_level)
    by (intros Hr; destruct (level_sorted_parameters_cons _ _ _ (HL Hr)) as [-> HL1]; split; [ exact HL1 | reflexivity ]).
  assert (Hk : pi_kinds κ r)
    by (destruct r eqn:Er; [ constructor | constructor | destruct (HL' eq_refl) as [_ ->]; constructor ]).
  (* the Π over the parameter, at the kind *)
  assert (HPi : exists k, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ a_pi κ r B A : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@k).
  { destruct r eqn:Er.
    - exact (wf_pi_sort_at _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HB HS HA ltac:(discriminate)).
    - exact (wf_pi_sort_at _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HB HS HA ltac:(discriminate)).
    - destruct (HL' eq_refl) as [_ ->]; inversion HS; subst; exists 0.
      eapply wf_pi with (U := Typeω@0) (κd := ak_level) (κc := ak_level);
        [ apply wf_is_univ_large; exact HΔ0 | exact HB | exact HA | constructor ]. }
  destruct HPi as [k Hk'].
  eapply IH with (i := k); [ exact Ha' | exact HΔ0 | intros Hr; exact (proj1 (HL' Hr)) | exact Hk' |].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_fn_cong with (i := i);
    [ exact HB | exact HS | apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact HB | exact HA | exact Hk | exact HM ].
Qed.

H.x ≈ λ Θ'. P.x N⃗: a member of a module expression whose module part is a filed module P at arguments N⃗ over outside parameters Θ' is the filed member at the arguments, abstracted over Θ': A.x ≈ P.x for module A := P, and L.c ≈ λ n. P.c for let module L (n : ℕ) := P. This is the case of an outside parameter or an argument, where the member is read as a name (mdesc_named); read bare, it goes by the module expressions (mem_closed_part).
Lemma mdesc_type_named : forall Θ' Ns M R, mdesc_type (mdesc_named Θ' Ns M R) = mdesc_type R.
Proof. intros; apply (mdesc_named_cases (fun R' => mdesc_type R' = mdesc_type R)); [ reflexivity | destruct R as [? ? [] | | |]; reflexivity ]. Qed.

An open frame, named by its path, is its module at no arguments and no outside parameters.
Lemma frame_denote_mod : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall Γ H R p T0 Φ0 Θ' pf T Φ Ns,
    mod_qname H = Some p -> gc_frame Ξ p = Some (T0, Φ0) -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H R ->
    mdesc_mod R = Some (mdesc_closed Θ' pf T Φ Ns) -> Θ' = nil /\ pf = p /\ Ns = nil.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg * Hq Hf Hm Hmd.
  destruct (frame_denote_unique _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ Hq Hm) as (Hu & Hk & Hr).
  destruct (gs_find_ind Ξ p) as [[[pq k] D] |] eqn:Ek.
  - destruct (frame_ind_loc _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ Ek) as (U & T1 & T2 & Φ2 & Mk & Ht & _ & Hl & HMk).
    rewrite (Hk _ _ _ _ _ _ eq_refl HMk Hl) in Hmd; cbn in Hmd.
    injection Hmd as <- <- _ _ <-; auto.
  - destruct (gs_find_record Ξ p) as [Rr |] eqn:Er.
    + destruct (frame_record_loc _ _ Hg _ _ Er) as (U & T1 & T2 & Φ2 & Ht & _ & Hl).
      rewrite (Hr _ _ _ eq_refl Hl) in Hmd; cbn in Hmd.
      injection Hmd as <- <- _ _ <-; auto.
    + rewrite (Hu _ _ (gc_unit_frame _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq Hf Ek Er)) in Hmd; cbn in Hmd.
      injection Hmd as <- <- _ _ <-; auto.
Qed.

The module of a member denoted at a record's open frame is that frame's parent, itself an open frame, named by its path.
Lemma record_frame_mem_mod : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall Γ H x p R RH Θ' pf T Φ Ns,
    mod_qname (me_mem H x) = Some p -> gs_find_record Ξ p = Some R -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H RH ->
    mdesc_mod RH = Some (mdesc_closed Θ' pf T Φ Ns) -> mod_qname H = Some pf /\ Θ' = nil /\ Ns = nil.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg * Hq Hk Hm Hmd.
  cbn in Hq; destruct (mod_qname H) as [mq |] eqn:Hq0; [| discriminate ]; injection Hq as <-.
  change {| q_unit := q_unit mq; q_chain := q_chain mq ++ x :: nil |} with (qname_in mq x) in Hk.
  destruct (gs_find_record_tele _ _ _ Hk) as (U & T0 & Ht).
  destruct (frame_parent _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ Ht) as (T' & Φ' & Hf & _).
  destruct (frame_denote_mod _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq0 Hf Hm Hmd) as (-> & -> & ->); auto.
Qed.

The module of a member denoted at an open frame is that frame's parent, itself an open frame, named by its path.
Lemma ind_frame_mem_mod : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall Γ H x p r RH Θ' pf T Φ Ns,
    mod_qname (me_mem H x) = Some p -> gs_find_ind Ξ p = Some r -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H RH ->
    mdesc_mod RH = Some (mdesc_closed Θ' pf T Φ Ns) -> mod_qname H = Some pf /\ Θ' = nil /\ Ns = nil.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg * Hq Hk Hm Hmd.
  cbn in Hq; destruct (mod_qname H) as [mq |] eqn:Hq0; [| discriminate ]; injection Hq as <-.
  change {| q_unit := q_unit mq; q_chain := q_chain mq ++ x :: nil |} with (qname_in mq x) in Hk.
  destruct (gs_find_ind_tele _ _ _ Hk) as (U & T0 & Ht).
  destruct (frame_parent _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ Ht) as (T' & Φ' & Hf & _).
  destruct (frame_denote_mod _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq0 Hf Hm Hmd) as (-> & -> & ->); auto.
Qed.

The parts of a member R of type A of a closed module part read at the outside parameters Θ', as a name: its δ-reduct is a body over Θ' equal to the name Mn, the filed member at the arguments, at the type A is over Θ' (mem_closed_part_named_parts): the body M' the δ-reduct abstracts over Θ', of the type A0 over Θ', of the kind r, whose sort is at the level i.
Record closed_member_named_parts (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ Θ' : ctx) (R : mdesc) (A Mn M' A0 : exp) (r : abs_kind) (i : nat) : Prop :=
  mk_closed_member_named_parts
  {
The δ-reduct is the body abstracted over Θ'
    closed_member_named_reduct : mdesc_reduct R = Some (ctx_fn Θ' M')
    
The type is the type over Θ' abstracted over it at the kind
  ; closed_member_named_type_eq : A = ctx_pi_at r Θ' A0
    
The kind is that of the description
  ; closed_member_named_kind_eq : mdesc_kind R = r
    
The outside parameters extend the context
  ; closed_member_named_ctx : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Θ' ++ Γ
    
The outside parameters are assumptions
  ; closed_member_named_assumptions : all_assumptions Θ'
    
The type over Θ' is of the sort of the kind
  ; closed_member_named_sort : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Θ' ++ Γ ⊢ A0 : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i
    
A type of levels is over parameters of types of levels
  ; closed_member_named_levels : r = ak_level -> level_sorted_parameters Θ'
    
The body is the name over Θ'
  ; closed_member_named_body_eq : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Θ' ++ Γ ⊢ M' ≈ Mn : A0 }.

Lemma mem_closed_part_named_parts : forall Θ Ξ Γ H RH Θ' p T Φ Ns x R A,
    Θ' <> nil \/ Ns <> nil ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H RH -> mdesc_mod RH = Some (mdesc_closed Θ' p T Φ Ns) ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H x) R -> mdesc_type R = Some A ->
    exists M' A0 r i, closed_member_named_parts Θ Ξ Γ Θ' R A (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns) M' A0 r i.
Proof.
  intros * Hne HH HmH HmdH Hm Ht.
  pose proof (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH) as HΓ; pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΓ) as Hg.
  pose proof (wf_gstack_closed _ _ Hg) as Hc.
  pose proof (gctx_valid_syn _ _ Hg) as Hv.
  pose proof (mdesc_canonical_mod _ _ _ _ (mdenote_canon _ _ _ _ _ Hg HmH) HmdH) as Hl; cbn in Hl.
  pose proof (desc_ok_mod _ _ Hg _ _ _ (me_desc_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ HH HmH) HmdH) as HokP.
  inversion HokP as [| | ? ? ? ? ? Θ1 Ξ1 ? lΘ Hg1 Hs1 Hl1 HaT HsT HT HΘ' Hargs HaΘ HRΘ |]; subst.
  inversion Hm as [? ? ? ? ? Hq Hu | ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? Hq Hk | | | | ? ? ? R0 R0m Γy E rd Re ? Hm0 Hmd He Hed Hr
                  | ? ? ? ? ? ? Hq Hk];
    subst.
  { cbn in Ht; discriminate. }
  { destruct (ind_frame_mem_mod _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq Hk HmH HmdH) as (_ & -> & ->).
    destruct Hne as [Hne | Hne]; contradiction. }
  2: { destruct (record_frame_mem_mod _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq Hk HmH HmdH) as (_ & -> & ->).
       destruct Hne as [Hne | Hne]; contradiction. }
  rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm0 _ HmH), HmdH in Hmd; injection Hmd as <-.
  pose proof (loc_closed _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl) as HU.
  destruct (mdesc_entry_closed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HU He) as (-> & HE & ->).
  cbn [mdesc_read] in Hr; destruct (mdesc_ats_read Re Ns) as [R1 |] eqn:Hats; cbn [option_map] in Hr; [ injection Hr as <- | discriminate ].
  (* the filed module at the arguments, under the outside parameters *)
  destruct (filed_apps_wf _ _ _ HΘ' _ _ _ Hl HaT HsT HT _ Hargs) as [HW _].
  destruct (filed_denote _ _ Hg _ _ _ (Θ' ++ Γ) Ns (gc_loc_of_loc _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl)) as (R0' & Hm0' & Hmd').
  assert (Hed' : edenote Θ Ξ (nil ++ Θ' ++ Γ) (mdesc_entry_path (mdesc_closed nil p T Φ Ns) x) E Re).
  { eapply edenote_closed_move; [ exact Hc | exact HE | exact Hed |].
    apply wk_mod_compat_sub; cbn [List.app]; apply (wf_wk_mod_compat Θ Ξ); apply wf_wk_shiftn_app; [ exact HΘ' | exact HΓ ]. }
  assert (Hmx : mdenote Θ Ξ (Θ' ++ Γ) (me_mem (me_apps (qname_mod p) Ns) x) (mdesc_up nil (mdesc_named nil Ns (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns) R1))).
  { assert (He' : mdesc_entry (mdesc_closed nil p T Φ Ns) x = Some (nil, E, reader_closed nil Ns (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns))).
    { cbn in He |- *; destruct (gm_prefix_upto Φ x) as [[| ? ? ? | ? ? ?] |]; try discriminate.
      injection He as HE1; rewrite HE1; reflexivity. }
    eapply mdenote_mem; [ exact Hm0' | exact Hmd' | exact He' | exact Hed' | cbn; rewrite Hats; reflexivity ]. }
  rewrite (mdesc_named_self _ _ Hne) in Ht, Hm.
  change (mdesc_up Θ' (mdesc_self (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns) R1)) with (mdesc_up (nil ++ Θ') (mdesc_self (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns) R1)) in Ht, Hm.
  rewrite mdesc_up_cat in Ht, Hm.
  destruct (mdesc_type_up_inv _ _ _ Ht) as (A0 & HA0 & ->).
  destruct (mdesc_reduct_closed_read _ _ _ _ HA0) as (M' & HM').
  assert (HA0x : mdesc_type (mdesc_up nil (mdesc_named nil Ns (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns) R1)) = Some A0).
  { rewrite <- HA0; apply (mdesc_named_cases (fun R' => mdesc_type (mdesc_up nil R') = mdesc_type (mdesc_up nil (mdesc_self (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns) R1))));
      [ destruct R1 as [? ? [] | | |] | ]; reflexivity. }
  destruct (desc_ok_ty_at _ _ _ _ _ (mem_desc_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hv HW Hmx) HA0x) as (i & Hi).
  assert (Hrel : mdesc_kind (mdesc_up nil (mdesc_named nil Ns (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns) R1))
                 = mdesc_kind (mdesc_self (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns) R1))
    by (rewrite mdesc_kind_up; unfold mdesc_named; destruct Ns; destruct R1 as [? ? [] | | |]; reflexivity).
  rewrite Hrel in Hi.
  pose proof (mem_filed_apps _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (gc_loc_of_loc _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl) HW Hmx HA0x) as Hfa.
  (* the member at the arguments is the filed member at them: by δ to
     the δ-reduct, which a term of none is read as *)
  assert (Heq : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Θ' ++ Γ ⊢ M' ≈ apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns : A0).
  { destruct (mdesc_reduct R1) as [M1 |] eqn:Er.
    - assert (Hs : mdesc_self (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns) R1 = R1) by (destruct R1 as [? ? [] | | |]; cbn in Er |- *; congruence).
      rewrite Hs in HM'; cbn [mdesc_up] in HM'.
