      assert (HMx : mdesc_reduct (mdesc_up nil (mdesc_named nil Ns (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns) R1)) = Some M')
        by (rewrite mdesc_named_fix by exact Hs; cbn [mdesc_up]; exact HM').
      eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [ apply wf_exp_eq_sym; eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_delta; [ exact HW | exact Hmx | exact HA0x | exact HMx ] |].
      exact Hfa.
    - destruct R1 as [? ? [] | | |]; cbn in Er, HA0, HM'; try discriminate; injection HM' as <-.
      eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [ apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Hfa | exact Hfa ]. }
  rewrite (mdesc_named_self _ _ Hne), mdesc_kind_up.
  change (mdesc_up Θ' (mdesc_self (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns) R1))
    with (mdesc_up (nil ++ Θ') (mdesc_self (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns) R1)); rewrite mdesc_up_cat.
  set (r := mdesc_kind (mdesc_self (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns) R1)) in *.
  (* the type is of the sort of its kind, abstracted over the outer
     parameters; a type of levels over parameters of types of levels, as a
     module with no member of a type of levels has no such term *)
  exists M', A0, r, i.
  refine (mk_closed_member_named_parts _ _ _ _ _ _ _ M' A0 r i _ eq_refl _ HΘ' HaΘ Hi _ Heq);
    [ rewrite mdesc_reduct_up, HM'; reflexivity | rewrite !mdesc_kind_up; reflexivity |].
  intros Hrl; destruct H0 as [HL | HNl]; [ exact HL | exfalso ].
  assert (Hr0 : mdesc_read (reader_closed Θ' Ns (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns)) Re =
                Some (mdesc_up Θ' (mdesc_named Θ' Ns (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns) R1)))
    by (cbn [mdesc_read]; rewrite Hats; reflexivity).
  destruct (desc_ok_entry_closed_read _ _ Hg Hv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HokP He Hed Hr0) as (Rr & [_ HRr Hty HN0]).
  rewrite Hats in HRr; injection HRr as <-.
  pose proof (HN0 HNl) as HNx; rewrite (mdesc_named_self _ _ Hne) in HNx.
  subst r; destruct R1 as [r1 A1 om1 | | | Θd A1 M1 Rm1]; cbn [mdesc_self mdesc_up mdesc_kind] in HNx, Hrl; try discriminate.
  (* a term of a type of levels has a member of a type of levels *)
  destruct om1; cbn [mdesc_kind] in Hrl; subst r1; inversion HNx; subst; contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma mem_closed_part_named : forall Θ Ξ Γ H RH Θ' p T Φ Ns x R A,
    Θ' <> nil \/ Ns <> nil ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H RH -> mdesc_mod RH = Some (mdesc_closed Θ' p T Φ Ns) ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H x) R -> mdesc_type R = Some A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_mem H x ≈ ctx_fn Θ' (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns) : A.
Proof.
  intros * Hne HH HmH HmdH Hm Ht.
  destruct (mem_closed_part_named_parts _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hne HH HmH HmdH Hm Ht) as (M' & A0 & r & i & [HM' -> _ HΘ' HaΘ Hi Hl Heq]).
  apply (wf_exp_eq_trans _ _ _ _ _ (ctx_fn Θ' M')); [ eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_delta; eassumption |].
  exact (ctx_fn_eq _ _ r _ _ _ _ _ i HaΘ HΘ' Hl Hi Heq).
Qed.

Every Module Is Equal to a Unit

A unit in normal form (unit_nf) is a filed module at arguments, a local body, or an alias with parameters of a unit in normal form. A well-formed module expression is equal to a unit in normal form that denotes the same module part (lookup_sound): a slot by its unit, a selection by the unit its module part stands for (mdesc_unit), an alias with no parameter by its target, and an application by β.

Inductive unit_nf (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) : modexp -> Prop :=
| unit_nf_filed : forall p T Φ Ns, loc Θ Ξ p T Φ -> unit_nf Θ Ξ (me_apps (qname_mod p) Ns)
| unit_nf_body : forall Δ Φ, unit_nf Θ Ξ (me_lit (gu_open Δ Φ))
| unit_nf_alias : forall Δ E, Δ <> nil -> unit_nf Θ Ξ E -> unit_nf Θ Ξ (me_lit (gu_mk Δ (md_alias E))).

Lemma unit_nf_sub : forall Θ Ξ K, unit_nf Θ Ξ K -> forall σ, unit_nf Θ Ξ K[σ]ᵐ.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [p T Φ Ns Hl | Δ Φ | Δ E HΔ HE IH]; intros σ.
  - rewrite me_apps_sub, qname_mod_sub; eapply unit_nf_filed; exact Hl.
  - cbn [modexp_sub]; rewrite gunit_sub_mk; apply unit_nf_body.
  - cbn [modexp_sub]; rewrite gunit_sub_mk; apply unit_nf_alias; [ destruct Δ; [ contradiction | discriminate ] | apply IH ].
Qed.

Lemma mdesc_unit_nf : forall Θ Ξ Rm, mdesc_canonical Θ Ξ Rm -> mdesc_is_mod Rm -> unit_nf Θ Ξ (mdesc_unit Rm).
Proof.
  intros * Hc Hm; destruct Rm as [A om | Δ Φ | [| e Θ'] p T Φ Ns | ]; cbn in Hm, Hc |- *; try contradiction.
  - apply unit_nf_body.
  - eapply unit_nf_filed; exact Hc.
  - apply unit_nf_alias; [ discriminate | eapply unit_nf_filed; exact Hc ].
Qed.

Lemma mdenote_lit_inv : forall Θ Ξ Γ U R, mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_lit U) R -> udenote Θ Ξ Γ None U R.
Proof. intros * Hm; inversion Hm; subst; first [ cbn in *; discriminate | assumption ]. Qed.

Lemma all_assumptions_last : forall Δ, all_assumptions Δ -> Δ <> nil -> exists Δ0 κ X, Δ = Δ0 ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil.
Proof.
  intros Δ Ha Hn; destruct (List.exists_last Hn) as (Δ0 & e & ->).
  apply List.Forall_app in Ha as [_ Ha]; apply List.Forall_cons_iff in Ha as [(κ & X & ->) _]; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma mdesc_tele_up_inv : forall Δ R T, mdesc_is_mod R -> mdesc_tele (mdesc_up Δ R) = Some T -> exists T0, T = T0 ++ Δ.
Proof.
  intros * Hm Ht; destruct R as [| Δ' Φ | Θ0 p T' Φ Ns |]; cbn in Hm, Ht; try contradiction.
  - injection Ht as <-; eauto.
  - destruct (Nat.leb _ _); [ injection Ht as <-; rewrite app_assoc; eauto | discriminate ].
Qed.

Lemma me_apps_qname_not_lit : forall p Ns U, me_apps (qname_mod p) Ns <> me_lit U.
Proof.
  intros * E; destruct Ns as [| N Ns _] using List.rev_ind; [| rewrite me_apps_snoc in E; discriminate ].
  pose proof (mod_qname_qname_mod p) as Hq; cbn [me_apps] in E; rewrite E in Hq; discriminate.
Qed.

The last parameter of a literal in normal form given an argument in a well-formed application: the argument is of its type.
Lemma lit_app_last : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall Γ U N RK, unit_nf Θ Ξ (me_lit U) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_app (me_lit U) N ≈ me_app (me_lit U) N -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_lit U) RK ->
    exists Δ0 κ X D, U = gu_mk (Δ0 ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) D /\ unit_full Θ Ξ Γ U /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N : X.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg * Hnf Hw Hm.
  destruct (proj1 (modexp_gen _ _ _ _ _ Hw)) as (HK & R0 & T & B & T1 & SB & Hm0 & HT & Hv & HB & HSB & HN); cbn [gen_m] in *.
  rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm0 _ Hm) in HT.
  pose proof (proj1 (modexp_gen _ _ _ _ _ HK)) as Hf; cbn [gen_m] in Hf.
  apply mdenote_lit_inv in Hm.
  inversion Hnf as [p T0 Φ0 Ns _ HU | Δ Φ HU | Δ E HΔ _ HU]; subst.
  - exfalso; exact (me_apps_qname_not_lit _ _ _ HU).
  - destruct (unit_full_ctx _ _ _ _ _ Hf) as [_ Ha].
    inversion Hm; subst.
    match goal with Hb : mdesc_body _ _ _ _ _ = Some _ |- _ => cbn in Hb; injection Hb as <- end.
    unfold mdesc_mod_tele in HT; cbn in HT; injection HT as <-.
    destruct Δ as [| e Δ']; [ cbn in Hv; discriminate |].
    destruct (all_assumptions_last _ Ha ltac:(discriminate)) as (Δ0 & κ & X & HΔ).
    rewrite HΔ, tele_view_last in Hv; injection Hv as <- _.
    exists Δ0, κ, X, (md_body sm_open Φ); rewrite <- HΔ; split; [ reflexivity | split; assumption ].
  - destruct (unit_full_ctx _ _ _ _ _ Hf) as [_ Ha].
    inversion Hm; subst.
    match goal with Hd : mdesc_mod _ = Some ?R' |- _ => pose proof (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ Hd) as Him end.
    unfold mdesc_mod_tele in HT; rewrite (mdesc_is_mod_mod _ (mdesc_is_mod_up _ _ Him)) in HT.
    destruct (mdesc_tele_up_inv _ _ _ Him HT) as (T0 & ->).
    destruct (all_assumptions_last _ Ha HΔ) as (Δ0 & κ & X & HΔ0).
    rewrite HΔ0, app_assoc, tele_view_last in Hv; injection Hv as <- _.
    exists Δ0, κ, X, (md_alias E); rewrite <- HΔ0; split; [ reflexivity | split; assumption ].
Qed.

A unit in normal form given an argument is equal to a unit in normal form denoting the same module part: a filed module at one more argument; a literal by β, and an alias left with no parameter by its target.
Lemma unit_nf_step : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall Γ K N RK RK', unit_nf Θ Ξ K ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_app K N ≈ me_app K N -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ K RK -> mdesc_at RK N = Some RK' ->
    exists K' RK'', unit_nf Θ Ξ K' /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_app K N ≈ K' /\ mdenote Θ Ξ Γ K' RK'' /\
      mdesc_mod RK'' = mdesc_mod RK'.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg * Hnf Hw Hm Ha.
  assert (HmA : mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_app K N) RK') by (eapply mdenote_app; eassumption).
  destruct Hnf as [p T Φ Ns Hl | Δ Φ | Δ E HΔ HE].
  - exists (me_app (me_apps (qname_mod p) Ns) N), RK'; split; [ rewrite <- me_apps_snoc; eapply unit_nf_filed; exact Hl |].
    split; [ exact Hw |]; split; [ exact HmA | reflexivity ].
  - destruct (lit_app_last _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ (unit_nf_body _ _ Δ Φ) Hw Hm) as (Δ0 & κ & X & D & HU & Hf & HN).
    injection HU as -> <-.
    pose proof (unit_eq_of_full _ _ _ _ Hf) as HU.
    destruct (mdenote_beta _ _ _ _ _ _ _ N HU _ (mdenote_lit_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hm)) as (R' & HmA' & HmL & _).
    rewrite <- (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ HmA' _ HmA).
    eexists; exists R'; split; [| split; [ exact (beta_step _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HU HN) | split; [ exact HmL | reflexivity ] ] ].
    rewrite gunit_sub_mk; apply unit_nf_body.
  - pose proof (unit_nf_alias _ _ _ _ HΔ HE) as Hnf.
    destruct (lit_app_last _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ Hnf Hw Hm) as (Δ0 & κ & X & D & HU & Hf & HN).
    injection HU as -> <-.
    pose proof (unit_eq_of_full _ _ _ _ Hf) as HU.
    destruct (mdenote_beta _ _ _ _ _ _ _ N HU _ (mdenote_lit_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hm)) as (R' & HmA' & HmL & HmdR').
    rewrite <- (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ HmA' _ HmA).
    pose proof (beta_step _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HU HN) as Hβ.
    rewrite gunit_sub_mk in Hβ, HmL; cbn [moddef_sub] in Hβ, HmL.
    destruct Δ0 as [| e Δ0'].
    + (* no parameter left: the target *)
      cbn [tele_sub length] in Hβ, HmL.
      pose proof (proj2 (modexp_gen _ _ _ _ _ Hβ)) as Hf'; cbn [gen_m unit_full] in Hf'; destruct Hf' as [lp ps' Hps' HΔ' Ha' HE'].
      cbn [List.app] in HE'.
      apply mdenote_lit_inv in HmL; inversion HmL as [| ? ? ? ? R1 R2 HmE HmdE HeqR]; subst.
      rewrite mdesc_up_nil in HmdR' |- *.
      exists E[sb_qn 0 (Id,,N)]ᵐ, R1; split; [ apply unit_nf_sub; exact HE |].
      split; [ eapply wf_me_trans; [ exact Hβ | apply wf_me_beta_alias0; [ exact HE' | exact unit_alias_frame_free ] ] |].
      split; [ exact HmE | rewrite HmdE, HmdR'; reflexivity ].
    + eexists; exists R'; split; [| split; [ exact Hβ | split; [ exact HmL | reflexivity ] ] ].
      apply unit_nf_alias; [ discriminate | apply unit_nf_sub; exact HE ].
Qed.

Lemma lookup_sound_all : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ ->
    (forall Γ H R, mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H R -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H -> forall Rm, mdesc_mod R = Some Rm ->
       exists K RK, unit_nf Θ Ξ K /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ K /\ mdenote Θ Ξ Γ K RK /\ mdesc_mod RK = Some Rm) /\
    (forall Γ o U R, udenote Θ Ξ Γ o U R -> o = None -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U -> forall Rm, mdesc_mod R = Some Rm ->
       exists K RK, unit_nf Θ Ξ K /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_lit U ≈ K /\ mdenote Θ Ξ Γ K RK /\ mdesc_mod RK = Some Rm) /\
    (forall Γ o E R, edenote Θ Ξ Γ o E R -> True) /\
    (forall Γ Φ Φx, body_xp Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx -> True) /\
    (forall Γ H its gs, items_gen Θ Ξ Γ H its gs -> True).
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg; apply mdenote_all_ind; try (intros; exact I).
  - (* a loaded unit or an open frame *)
    intros Γ H p T Φ Hq Hu HH Rm Hmd.
    destruct (gc_unit_loc _ _ _ _ _ Hu) as (mp & Hq' & Hl); rewrite Hq in Hq'; injection Hq' as <-.
    exists H, (mdesc_closed nil p T Φ nil); split; [ rewrite (mod_qname_inv _ _ Hq); exact (unit_nf_filed _ _ p T Φ nil Hl) |].
    split; [ exact HH |]; split; [ apply mdenote_unit; assumption | exact Hmd ].
  - (* the open frame of a member's module: itself, a filed module *)
    intros Γ H p pq k D Mk Tm Φm Hq Hk HMk Hl HH Rm Hmd; cbn in Hmd.
    exists H, (ind_former_desc pq k D Mk (mdesc_closed nil p Tm Φm nil)).
    split; [ rewrite (mod_qname_inv _ _ Hq); exact (unit_nf_filed _ _ p Tm Φm nil (gc_loc_loc _ _ _ _ _ Hl)) |].
    split; [ exact HH |]; split; [ eapply mdenote_ind_frame; eassumption | exact Hmd ].
  - (* a slot: its unit *)
    intros Γ x U R Hx Hu IH HH Rm Hmd.
    pose proof (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH) as HΓ.
    destruct (IH eq_refl (ctx_lookup_mod_wf _ _ _ _ _ HΓ Hx) Rm Hmd) as (K & RK & Hnf & HK & HmK & HmdK).
    exists K, RK; split; [ exact Hnf |]; split; [ eapply wf_me_trans; [ eapply wf_me_delta_slot; eassumption | exact HK ] |].
    split; assumption.
  - (* a literal *)
    intros Γ U R Hu IH HH Rm Hmd.
    pose proof (proj1 (modexp_gen _ _ _ _ _ HH)) as Hf; cbn [gen_m] in Hf.
    exact (IH eq_refl (unit_eq_of_full _ _ _ _ Hf) Rm Hmd).
  - (* an application: the unit the module is equal to, given the argument *)
    intros Γ H N R R' Hm IH Ha HH Rm Hmd.
    destruct (proj1 (modexp_gen _ _ _ _ _ HH)) as (HH0 & R0 & T & B & T1 & SB & Hm0 & HT & Hv & HB & HSB & HN); cbn [gen_m] in *.
    rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm0 _ Hm) in HT.
    unfold mdesc_mod_tele in HT; destruct (mdesc_mod R) as [Rm0 |] eqn:Hmd0; [| discriminate ].
    destruct (IH HH0 Rm0 eq_refl) as (K & RK & Hnf & HK & HmK & HmdK).
    destruct (mdesc_mod_at _ _ _ _ Hmd0 Ha) as (Rm' & Ha0 & Hmd'); rewrite Hmd in Hmd'; injection Hmd' as <-.
    destruct (mdesc_mod_at_inv _ _ _ _ HmdK Ha0) as (RK' & HaK & HmdK').
    assert (HKN : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_app H N ≈ me_app K N).
    { eapply wf_me_app; [ exact HK | exact Hm | unfold mdesc_mod_tele; rewrite Hmd0; exact HT | exact Hv | exact HB | exact HSB
                        | exact HN | apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact HN | exact HmK | unfold mdesc_mod_tele; rewrite HmdK; exact HT
                        | exact Hv | exact HB | exact HSB | exact HN ]. }
    destruct (unit_nf_step _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ Hnf (wf_modexp_eq_refl_right HKN) HmK HaK)
      as (K' & RK'' & Hnf' & HK' & HmK' & HmdK'').
    exists K', RK''; split; [ exact Hnf' |]; split; [ eapply wf_me_trans; eassumption |].
    split; [ exact HmK' | rewrite HmdK''; exact HmdK' ].
  - (* a selection: the unit its module part stands for *)
    intros Γ H y R0 R0m Γy E rd R R' Hm _ Hmd0 He Hed _ Hrd HH Rm Hmd.
    assert (Hsel : mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H y) R') by (eapply mdenote_mem; eassumption).
    pose proof (mdesc_canonical_mod _ _ _ _ (mdenote_canon _ _ _ _ _ Hg Hsel) Hmd) as Hc.
    pose proof (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ Hmd) as Him.
    destruct (mdesc_unit_denote _ _ _ Hg Hc Him Γ (wf_mdenote_mod_xp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HH Hsel Hmd)) as (RK & HmK & HmdK).
    exists (mdesc_unit Rm), RK; split; [ exact (mdesc_unit_nf _ _ _ Hc Him) |].
    split; [ eapply wf_me_delta_sel; eassumption |]; split; assumption.
  - (* the open frame of a record's module: itself, a filed module *)
    intros Γ H p R Tm Φm Hq Hk Hl HH Rm Hmd; cbn in Hmd.
    exists H, (record_former_desc p R (mdesc_closed nil p Tm Φm nil)).
    split; [ rewrite (mod_qname_inv _ _ Hq); exact (unit_nf_filed _ _ p Tm Φm nil (gc_loc_loc _ _ _ _ _ Hl)) |].
    split; [ exact HH |]; split; [ eapply mdenote_record_frame; eassumption | exact Hmd ].
  - (* a body *)
    intros Γ o Δ sm Φ Φx R Hx _ Hb -> HU Rm Hmd.
    destruct sm; cbn in Hb; [ injection Hb as <- | discriminate ].
    exists (me_lit (gu_open Δ Φ)), (mdesc_open Δ Φ Φx); split; [ apply unit_nf_body |].
    split; [ apply wf_me_lit; exact HU |]; split; [ apply mdenote_lit; eapply udenote_body; [ exact Hx | reflexivity ] | exact Hmd ].
  - (* an alias: with no parameter its target, otherwise over the unit its target is equal to *)
    intros Γ o Δ E R R' Hm IH HR' -> HU Rm Hmd.
    pose proof (proj1 (unit_full_of_eq _ _ _ _ _ HU)) as Hf; cbn [unit_full] in Hf.
    destruct Hf as [lp ps Hps HΔ Ha HE HRp lv Rt [HLs HLd HLn] Hff].
    destruct (IH HE R' HR') as (K & RK & Hnf & HK & HmK & HmdK).
    pose proof (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ HR') as Him.
    (* the target in normal form is no module still being defined: its
       module part is the target's *)
    assert (HffK : frame_free_target Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) K).
    { destruct Hff as (Rf & Hmf & Hnf'); rewrite <- (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm _ Hmf) in Hnf'.
      exists RK; split; [ exact HmK |].
      intros (Θ1 & p1 & T1 & Φ1 & Ns1 & Hm1 & Hf1); apply Hnf'; rewrite HmdK in Hm1; injection Hm1 as ->.
      do 5 eexists; split; [ exact HR' | exact Hf1 ]. }
    destruct Δ as [| e Δ'].
    + rewrite mdesc_up_nil, (mdesc_is_mod_mod _ Him) in Hmd; injection Hmd as <-.
      exists K, RK; split; [ exact Hnf |]; split; [ eapply wf_me_trans; [ apply wf_me_beta_alias0; [ exact HE | exact Hff ] | exact HK ] |].
      split; assumption.
    + exists (me_lit (gu_mk (e :: Δ') (md_alias K))), (mdesc_up (e :: Δ') R'); split; [ apply unit_nf_alias; [ discriminate | exact Hnf ] |].
      (* the target in normal form keeps the flag: its module part is the target's *)
      split; [ apply wf_me_lit; eapply wf_unit_eq_alias with (param_level := lp) (param_sorts := ps) (lv := lv) (lv' := lv) (Rt := Rt) (Rt' := RK);
               [ apply ext_of_ctx; exact HΔ | exact Ha | exact Ha | exact HK | exact (wf_modexp_eq_refl_right HK)
               | exact Hps | exact HRp | exact HRp | exact HLs | exact HLd | exact HLn | exact HLs
               | intros _; exact HmK
               | intros Hlv; pose proof (HLn Hlv) as HN;
                 rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ (HLd Hlv) _ Hm) in HN;
                 exact (no_level_of_mod _ _ _ _ _ HmdK (no_level_mod _ _ _ _ _ HN HR'))
               | exact Hff | exact HffK ] |].
      split; [ apply mdenote_lit; eapply udenote_alias; [ exact HmK | exact HmdK ] | exact Hmd ].
Qed.

A well-formed module expression is equal to a unit in normal form denoting its module part.
Lemma lookup_sound_nf : forall Θ Ξ Γ H R Rm, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H R -> mdesc_mod R = Some Rm ->
    exists K RK, unit_nf Θ Ξ K /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ K /\ mdenote Θ Ξ Γ K RK /\ mdesc_mod RK = Some Rm.
Proof.
  intros * HH Hm Hmd.
  pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH)) as Hg.
  exact (proj1 (lookup_sound_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm HH _ Hmd).
Qed.

Units in Normal Form Are the Units of What They Denote

A unit in normal form is the unit of the module part it denotes (mdesc_unit): a filed module at arguments is itself, a local body its own literal as written, and an alias with parameters of a unit in normal form the alias of that unit's unit, which flattening merges when it is a literal.
A literal well formed as a module expression is a well-formed unit.
Lemma lit_unit_wf : forall Θ Ξ Γ U, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_lit U ≈ me_lit U -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U.
Proof.
  intros * HU; pose proof (proj1 (modexp_gen _ _ _ _ _ HU)) as Hf; cbn [gen_m] in Hf; exact (unit_eq_of_full _ _ _ _ Hf).
Qed.

The unit a module part reading no open frame stands for reads none: it denotes that module part again (mdesc_unit_denote).
Lemma mdesc_unit_frame_free : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall Γ Rm, mdesc_canonical Θ Ξ Rm -> mdesc_is_mod Rm ->
    mdesc_xp Θ Ξ Γ Rm -> ~ desc_reads_frame Ξ Rm -> frame_free_target Θ Ξ Γ (mdesc_unit Rm).
Proof.
  intros * Hg * Hc Hm Hx Hn.
  destruct (mdesc_unit_denote _ _ _ Hg Hc Hm _ Hx) as (Ru & Hmu & Hmdu).
  exists Ru; split; [ exact Hmu |].
  intros (Θ' & p & T & Φ & Ns & Hm' & Hf); apply Hn; rewrite Hmdu in Hm'; injection Hm' as ->.
  do 5 eexists; split; [ reflexivity | exact Hf ].
Qed.

The literal an alias of a literal flattens to is well formed when the alias is.
Lemma flatten_unit_wf : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ Δ' D,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_mk Δ (md_alias (me_lit (gu_mk Δ' D))) ≈ gu_mk Δ (md_alias (me_lit (gu_mk Δ' D))) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_mk (Δ' ++ Δ) D ≈ gu_mk (Δ' ++ Δ) D.
Proof.
  intros * HU; pose proof (proj1 (unit_full_of_eq _ _ _ _ _ HU)) as Hf; cbn [unit_full] in Hf.
  destruct Hf as [lp ps Hps HC Ha HE HRp lv Rt [Hf1 Hf2 Hf3] Hff].
  eapply wf_unit_eq_refl_right; eapply wf_unit_eq_flatten with (param_level := lp) (param_sorts := ps) (lv := lv) (Rt := Rt);
    [ apply ext_of_ctx; exact HC | exact Ha | apply lit_unit_wf; exact HE | exact Hps | exact HRp | exact Hf1 | exact Hf2 | exact Hf3
    | exact Hff ].
Qed.

An alias with parameters of the unit of a module part is the unit of the module part abstracted over the parameters, under the alias's flag premise.
Lemma alias_unit_up : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ Rm l ps (lv : bool) Rt, Δ <> nil -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Δ ≈ Δ -> all_assumptions Δ ->
    (forall k, parameter_sort l (ps k)) ->
    (forall Δ1 κ T Δ2, Δ = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ2 ++ Γ ⊢ T : ps (List.length Δ2)) ->
    levels_flag Θ Ξ Γ Δ (mdesc_unit Rm) lv Rt -> mdesc_is_mod Rm ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ mdesc_unit Rm ≈ mdesc_unit Rm ->
    frame_free_target Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) (mdesc_unit Rm) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_lit (gu_mk Δ (md_alias (mdesc_unit Rm))) ≈ mdesc_unit (mdesc_up Δ Rm).
Proof.
  intros * Hne HΔ Ha Hps HRp [Hf1 Hf2 Hf3] Hm HR Hff.
  destruct Rm as [A om | Δ' Φ | [| e Θ'] p T Φ Ns | ]; cbn in Hm; try contradiction; cbn [mdesc_up mdesc_unit] in Hf1, Hf2, Hf3, HR, Hff |- *.
  - (* a local body: flattened *)
    apply wf_me_lit; eapply wf_unit_eq_flatten with (param_level := l) (param_sorts := ps) (lv := lv) (Rt := Rt);
      [ exact HΔ | exact Ha | apply lit_unit_wf; exact HR | exact Hps | exact HRp | exact Hf1 | exact Hf2 | exact Hf3 | exact Hff ].
  - (* a filed module at arguments: the alias is the unit *)
    rewrite app_nil_l; destruct Δ as [| e Δ]; [ contradiction |]; apply wf_me_lit;
      eapply wf_unit_eq_alias with (param_level := l) (param_sorts := ps) (lv := lv) (Rt := Rt) (lv' := lv) (Rt' := Rt);
      [ exact HΔ | exact Ha | exact Ha | exact HR | exact HR | exact Hps | exact HRp | exact HRp
      | exact Hf1 | exact Hf2 | exact Hf3 | exact Hf1 | exact Hf2 | exact Hf3 | exact Hff | exact Hff ].
  - (* an alias of a filed module at arguments: flattened *)
    apply wf_me_lit; eapply wf_unit_eq_flatten with (param_level := l) (param_sorts := ps) (lv := lv) (Rt := Rt);
      [ exact HΔ | exact Ha | apply lit_unit_wf; exact HR | exact Hps | exact HRp | exact Hf1 | exact Hf2 | exact Hf3 | exact Hff ].
Qed.

Lemma unit_nf_canon : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> forall K, unit_nf Θ Ξ K -> forall Γ RK Rm,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ K ≈ K -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ K RK -> mdesc_mod RK = Some Rm -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ K ≈ mdesc_unit Rm.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Hg K Hnf; induction Hnf as [p T Φ Ns Hl | Δ Φ | Δ E HΔ HE IH]; intros * HK Hm Hmd.
  - destruct (filed_denote _ _ Hg _ _ _ Γ Ns (gc_loc_of_loc _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl)) as (R0 & Hm0 & Hmd0).
    rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm _ Hm0), Hmd0 in Hmd; injection Hmd as <-; exact HK.
  - (* a local body: its own literal *)
    apply mdenote_lit_inv in Hm; inversion Hm; subst.
    match goal with Hb : mdesc_body _ _ _ _ _ = Some _ |- _ => cbn in Hb; injection Hb as <- end.
    cbn in Hmd; injection Hmd as <-; cbn [mdesc_unit]; exact HK.
  - (* an alias with parameters: its target, then the alias of the target's unit *)
    pose proof (proj1 (modexp_gen _ _ _ _ _ HK)) as Hf; cbn [gen_m unit_full] in Hf;
      destruct Hf as [lp ps Hps HC Ha HEE HRp lv Rt HF Hff].
    apply mdenote_lit_inv in Hm; inversion Hm as [| ? ? ? ? RE R'' HmE HmdE]; subst.
    pose proof (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ HmdE) as Him.
    rewrite (mdesc_is_mod_mod _ (mdesc_is_mod_up _ _ Him)) in Hmd; injection Hmd as <-.
    pose proof (IH _ _ _ HEE HmE HmdE) as HEu.
    (* the unit of the target's module part is no module still being
       defined, as the target is not *)
    assert (HnR : ~ desc_reads_frame Ξ R'').
    { destruct Hff as (Rf & Hmf & Hnf); rewrite <- (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ HmE _ Hmf) in Hnf.
      intros Hr; exact (Hnf (desc_reads_frame_mod _ _ _ HmdE Hr)). }
    pose proof (mdesc_unit_frame_free _ _ Hg _ _ (mdesc_canonical_mod _ _ _ _ (mdenote_canon _ _ _ _ _ Hg HmE) HmdE) Him
                  (wf_mdenote_mod_xp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HEE HmE HmdE) HnR) as HffU.
    (* the flag premise for the unit of the target's module part: what it
       denotes has the module part the target's has *)
    assert (HFu : exists lv' Rt', levels_flag Θ Ξ Γ Δ (mdesc_unit R'') lv' Rt').
    { destruct HF as [Hf1 Hf2 Hf3]; destruct lv.
      - exists true, Rt; constructor; [ exact Hf1 | discriminate | discriminate ].
      - pose proof (mdesc_canonical_mod _ _ _ _ (mdenote_canon _ _ _ _ _ Hg HmE) HmdE) as Hcan.
        destruct (mdesc_unit_denote _ _ _ Hg Hcan Him (Δ ++ Γ) (wf_mdenote_mod_xp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HEE HmE HmdE))
          as (Ru & Hmu & Hmdu).
        rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ HmE _ (Hf2 eq_refl)) in HmdE.
        exists false, Ru; constructor; [ discriminate | intros _; exact Hmu |].
        intros _; exact (no_level_of_mod _ _ _ _ _ Hmdu (no_level_mod _ _ _ _ _ (Hf3 eq_refl) HmdE)). }
    destruct HFu as (lv' & Rt' & HFu).
    eapply wf_me_trans;
      [ apply wf_me_lit; eapply wf_unit_eq_alias with (param_level := lp) (param_sorts := ps) (lv := lv) (Rt := Rt) (lv' := lv') (Rt' := Rt');
        [ apply ext_of_ctx; exact HC | exact Ha | exact Ha | exact HEu | exact (wf_modexp_eq_refl_right HEu)
        | exact Hps | exact HRp | exact HRp
        | exact (levels_flag_sorted _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HF) | exact (levels_flag_denotes _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HF)
        | exact (levels_flag_no_level _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HF)
        | exact (levels_flag_sorted _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HFu) | exact (levels_flag_denotes _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HFu)
        | exact (levels_flag_no_level _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HFu) | exact Hff | exact HffU ] |].
    eapply alias_unit_up;
      [ exact HΔ | apply ext_of_ctx; exact HC | exact Ha | exact Hps | exact HRp | exact HFu | exact Him
      | exact (wf_modexp_eq_refl_right HEu) | exact HffU ].
Qed.

Lookup is sound: a well-formed module expression is equal to the unit of the module part of what it denotes, H ≈ ⌜R̂⌝.
Theorem lookup_sound : forall Θ Ξ Γ H R Rm, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H R -> mdesc_mod R = Some Rm ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ mdesc_unit Rm.
Proof.
  intros * HH Hm Hmd.
  pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH)) as Hg.
  destruct (lookup_sound_nf _ _ _ _ _ _ HH Hm Hmd) as (K & RK & Hnf & HK & HmK & HmdK).
  eapply wf_me_trans; [ exact HK |].
  exact (unit_nf_canon _ _ Hg _ Hnf _ _ _ (wf_modexp_eq_refl_right HK) HmK HmdK).
Qed.

A.x ≈ P.x, for module A := P: the module expression is the filed module (lookup_sound), and the member reads the same entry of it.
Lemma mem_alias_filed : forall Θ Ξ Γ H p T Φ RH x R A,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H RH -> mdesc_mod RH = Some (mdesc_closed nil p T Φ nil) ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H x) R -> mdesc_type R = Some A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_mem H x ≈ a_mem (qname_mod p) x : A.
Proof.
  intros * HH HmH HmdH Hm Ht.
  pose proof (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH) as HΓ; pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΓ) as Hg.
  pose proof (lookup_sound _ _ _ _ _ _ HH HmH HmdH) as HHp; cbn [mdesc_unit me_apps] in HHp.
  pose proof (mdesc_canonical_mod _ _ _ _ (mdenote_canon _ _ _ _ _ Hg HmH) HmdH) as Hl; cbn in Hl.
  inversion Hm as [? ? ? ? ? Hq Hu | ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? Hq Hk | | | | ? ? ? R0 R0m Γy E rd Re ? Hm0 Hmd He Hed Hr
                  | ? ? ? ? ? ? Hq Hk];
    subst.
  { cbn in Ht; discriminate. }
  { (* the open frame of a member's module: H is the filed module itself *)
    destruct (ind_frame_mem_mod _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq Hk HmH HmdH) as (Hp & _ & _).
    rewrite (mod_qname_inv _ _ Hp) in Hm |- *.
    apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact (wf_mem_desc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (wf_modexp_eq_refl_right HHp) Hm Ht). }
  2: { (* the open frame of a record's module: H is the filed module itself *)
    destruct (record_frame_mem_mod _ _ Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq Hk HmH HmdH) as (Hp & _ & _).
    rewrite (mod_qname_inv _ _ Hp) in Hm |- *.
    apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact (wf_mem_desc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (wf_modexp_eq_refl_right HHp) Hm Ht). }
  rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm0 _ HmH), HmdH in Hmd; injection Hmd as <-.
  destruct (filed_denote _ _ Hg _ _ _ Γ nil (gc_loc_of_loc _ _ Hg _ _ _ Hl)) as (Rp & Hmp & Hmdp); cbn [me_apps] in Hmp.
  assert (Hmx : mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem (qname_mod p) x) R)
    by (eapply mdenote_mem; [ exact Hmp | exact Hmdp | exact He | exact Hed | exact Hr ]).
  eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_cong; [ exact HHp | exact Hm | exact Ht | exact Hmx | exact Ht |].
  exact (wf_mem_desc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (wf_modexp_eq_refl_right HHp) Hmx Ht).
Qed.

H.x ≈ λ Θ'. P.x N⃗, for a module expression whose module part is a filed module P at arguments N⃗ over outside parameters Θ': as a name (mem_closed_part_named), or, read bare, the filed member (mem_alias_filed).
Theorem mem_closed_part : forall Θ Ξ Γ H RH Θ' p T Φ Ns x R A,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ H RH -> mdesc_mod RH = Some (mdesc_closed Θ' p T Φ Ns) ->
    mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_mem H x) R -> mdesc_type R = Some A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_mem H x ≈ ctx_fn Θ' (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) x) Ns) : A.
Proof.
  intros * HH HmH HmdH Hm Ht.
  destruct Θ' as [| e Θ'']; [ destruct Ns as [| N Ns'] |].
  - exact (mem_alias_filed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HH HmH HmdH Hm Ht).
  - eapply mem_closed_part_named; [ right; discriminate | eassumption .. ].
  - eapply mem_closed_part_named; [ left; discriminate | eassumption .. ].
Qed.

The unit of a module part abstracted over Δ is well formed only if what the unit of the module part denotes under Δ can be abstracted over it: the flag premise of the abstracted unit's rule, read back. For example, the unit of a submodule B of module A (l : Level) ≔ … is read over l at B's own parameters and l.
Lemma up_unit_levels : forall Θm Ξm, ⊢ᵍ Θm ⍮ Ξm -> forall Γ Δ X, mdesc_is_mod X ->
    Θm ⍮ Ξm ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ mdesc_unit (mdesc_up Δ X) ≈ mdesc_unit (mdesc_up Δ X) ->
    forall R, mdenote Θm Ξm (Δ ++ Γ) (mdesc_unit X) R -> desc_levels_abstractable Θm Ξm Γ Δ R.
Proof.
  intros Θm Ξm Hgm * Hm Hw R HR.
  destruct Δ as [| e0 Δ0]; [ apply desc_levels_abstractable_nil |].
  pose proof (proj1 (modexp_gen _ _ _ _ _ Hw)) as Hf.
  destruct X as [A om | Δe Φ Φx | [| e Θ'] p T Φ Ns | Θd Ad Md Rm]; cbn in Hm; try contradiction;
    cbn [mdesc_up mdesc_unit gen_m unit_full] in Hf, HR.
  - (* an open module part: the flag of the flattened body *)
    destruct Hf as [Φx' es lp ps Hps Hx HC Hes Htg Hd Ho Ha Hs Hsx Hn Hp lv Rt [Hs1 Hd1 Hn1]].
    destruct lv; [ left; exact (proj2 (level_sorted_app_inv _ _ (Hs1 eq_refl))) | right ].
    specialize (Hd1 eq_refl); specialize (Hn1 eq_refl).
    apply mdenote_lit_inv in HR; inversion HR; subst.
    match goal with Hb : mdesc_body _ _ _ _ _ = Some _ |- _ => cbn in Hb; injection Hb as <- end.
    apply mdenote_lit_inv in Hd1; inversion Hd1; subst.
    match goal with Hb : mdesc_body _ _ _ _ _ = Some _ |- _ => cbn in Hb; injection Hb as <- end.
    match goal with Hx1 : body_xp _ _ (Δe ++ _) Φ ?Φ1, Hx2 : body_xp _ _ (nil ++ _) Φ ?Φ2 |- _ =>
      cbn [List.app] in Hx2; rewrite <- List.app_assoc in Hx2;
      pose proof (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hgm)))) _ _ _ Hx1 _ Hx2) as <- end.
    eapply no_level_open_shift; [| exact Hn1 ]; rewrite List.app_nil_l, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity.
  - (* a filed module at arguments, read bare: the alias's flag *)
    destruct Hf as [lp ps Hps HC Ha HE Hp lv Rt [Hs1 Hd1 Hn1]].
    destruct lv; [ left; exact (Hs1 eq_refl) | right ].
    rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hgm) _ _ _ HR _ (Hd1 eq_refl)); exact (Hn1 eq_refl).
  - (* an alias of a filed module at arguments: the flag of the flattened alias *)
    destruct Hf as [lp ps Hps HC Ha HE Hp lv Rt [Hs1 Hd1 Hn1]].
    destruct lv; [ left; exact (proj2 (level_sorted_app_inv _ _ (Hs1 eq_refl))) | right ].
    specialize (Hd1 eq_refl); specialize (Hn1 eq_refl).
    apply mdenote_lit_inv in HR; inversion HR as [| ? ? ? ? RE REm HmE HmdE]; subst.
    rewrite <- List.app_assoc in Hd1.
    rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hgm) _ _ _ HmE _ Hd1) in HmdE.
    rewrite <- List.app_assoc in Hn1.
    exact (proj2 (no_level_up_mod _ _ _ _ _ (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ HmdE)) (no_level_mod _ _ _ _ _ Hn1 HmdE)).
Qed.

The same for the frame premise: the unit of a module part that a well-formed unit abstracts over parameters is no module still being defined there, as that unit's alias target is not.
Lemma up_unit_frame_free : forall Θm Ξm, ⊢ᵍ Θm ⍮ Ξm -> forall Γ Δ X, mdesc_is_mod X ->
    Θm ⍮ Ξm ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ mdesc_unit (mdesc_up Δ X) ≈ mdesc_unit (mdesc_up Δ X) -> Δ <> nil ->
    frame_free_target Θm Ξm (Δ ++ Γ) (mdesc_unit X).
Proof.
  intros Θm Ξm Hgm * Hm Hw Hne.
  pose proof (proj1 (modexp_gen _ _ _ _ _ Hw)) as Hf.
  destruct X as [A om | Δe Φ Φx | [| e Θ'] p T Φ Ns | Θd Ad Md Rm]; cbn in Hm; try contradiction;
    cbn [mdesc_up mdesc_unit gen_m unit_full] in Hf |- *.
  - (* an open module part: a body, which denotes an open description *)
    destruct Hf as [Φx' es lp ps Hps Hx].
    exists (mdesc_open Δe Φ Φx'); split.
    + apply mdenote_lit; eapply udenote_body; [ rewrite List.app_assoc; exact Hx | reflexivity ].
    + intros (? & ? & ? & ? & ? & Hm' & _); cbn in Hm'; discriminate.
  - (* a filed module at arguments: the alias's own target *)
    destruct Δ as [| e0 Δ0]; [ contradiction |].
    destruct Hf as [lp ps Hps HC Ha HE Hp lv Rt HF Hff]; exact Hff.
  - (* an alias of a filed module at arguments: its target, abstracted *)
    destruct Hf as [lp ps Hps HC Ha HE Hp lv Rt HF (R1 & Hm1 & Hn1)].
    destruct (me_denotes _ _ _ _ _ HE) as (R2 & R2m & Hm2 & Hmd2).
    rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hgm) _ _ _ Hm2 _ Hm1) in Hmd2.
    exists (mdesc_up (e :: Θ') R2m); split.
    + apply mdenote_lit; eapply udenote_alias; [ rewrite List.app_assoc; exact Hm1 | exact Hmd2 ].
    + intros Hr; apply Hn1; exact (desc_reads_frame_mod _ _ _ Hmd2 (proj1 (desc_reads_frame_up _ _ _) Hr)).
Qed.
